jobs.title: Project Manager - Southwest
jobs.description:
Your Job

DEPCOM Power, a leading renewable energy EPC firm, is seeking a Project Manager for the Southwest portfolio to lead the execution of utility-scale Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage, and Repowering projects from pre-construction through commissioning and closeout.

As a Project Manager, you will create long-term value by leading project teams that deliver safe, reliable, and profitable results. You will apply Principle Based Management to strengthen ownership, improve execution discipline, make sound economic decisions, and build trusted customer and stakeholder relationships from pre-construction through closeout.

This is a remote role that requires travel to field construction project sites at a frequency between 25% - 50% dependent on project need.

Our Team

DEPCOM’s Project Delivery Organization executes turnkey PV, Battery Energy Storage, and Repower projects, including collection substations and generation transmission lines. The team partners with vendors, subcontractors, utilities, and internal capabilities to deliver disciplined project execution and strong customer outcomes nationwide.

What You Will Do

Lead project teams to deliver safe, reliable, and profitable outcomes across scope, schedule, cost, quality, compliance, and customer expectations.
Develop and execute project plans, forecasts, risk mitigation strategies, and phase-gate deliverables from pre-construction through commissioning and closeout.
Apply economic thinking to evaluate cost, risk, schedule, and value tradeoffs while making timely decisions that improve project outcomes.
Build and develop high-performing teams by setting clear expectations, coaching for contribution, and aligning strengths to project and business needs.
Coordinate customers, subcontractors, vendors, utilities, consultants, and internal partners to support transparent communication and disciplined execution.
Strengthen customer and stakeholder relationships by resolving challenges, honoring commitments, and creating mutual long-term value.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Experience managing EPC, industrial, infrastructure, utility scale renewable energy, or large capital projects valued in the hundreds of millions of dollars
Experience managing project scope, schedule, cost, forecasting, risk mitigation, contracts, or customer commitments.
Experience leading project teams, subcontractors, vendors, or cross-functional stakeholders.
Valid US driver’s license.
Legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship now or in the future.

What Will Put You Ahead

EPC experience in Utility Solar, Wind, BESS, conventional power or industrial projects.
Experience leading self-perform construction execution on large or complex projects.
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
PMP, CCM, PE, or other relevant project management or construction industry certifications.
Experience partnering with Business Development, Estimating, Operations, or customers to support project pursuits, repeat business, and executable project solutions.

For this role, we anticipate paying $150K - $200K per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch Engineered Solutions company, DEPCOM Power is a leading energy solutions partner for the utility solar and broader energy industries, providing project development support, engineering, procurement and construction, energy storage, repowering and operations and maintenance services. Our highly skilled team of conventional and renewable power industry experts work to deliver the lowest cost of energy and the highest rate of return.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Republic Finance is a dynamic and innovative company at the forefront of the consumer finance industry. We’ve been in business for over 70 years, and we are proud to be a trusted lender in over 250 communities across the United States! We are driven by our shared mission to pursue excellence for our customers and are seeking a Project Manager
to join our team. If you’re passionate about managing projects, driving results, and contributing to our ongoing business transformation, we want to hear from you! The PMO team can work remotely from Baton Rouge, LA, or follow a hybrid schedule in Plano, TX or Charlotte, NC. For the right candidate, this position may be remote, provided the individual resides in a state where we currently operate, with low to moderate travel to our headquarters locations.

As a Project Manager
at Republic Finance you will play a pivotal role in planning, executing, and delivering projects on time and within budget. You will be responsible for ensuring project objectives are met, managing resources effectively, and encouraging strong cross-functional collaboration. We look for organized individuals that are self-starters, skilled in critical thinking, building project plans, and guiding large project teams to delivery of successful initiatives on time and under budget. Job responsibilities are as follows:

Lead projects from initiation to closure, including but not limited to, working with project leadership to define project scope, goals, and deliverables, developing, revising, and maintaining complex project plans, tracking tasks, timelines, and resource allocations and ensuring all project documentation is accurate and up to date.
Deliver clear, consistent, and effective verbal and written communication to project teams, project partners and Project Management Office leadership. Foster and maintain positive relationships within the project team and other departments.
Document and escalate project risks. Assist with identifying, preventing, and mitigating risks throughout the project to minimize impact on project timelines and deliverables.
Promote cross-team collaboration to assist project team members in completing tasks and resolving conflicts or issues that arise throughout the project life cycle.
Leverage Project Management Office (PMO) tools, templates, and standardized project processes. Actively participate in PMO process improvement reviews and special assignments.
Assist Senior Project Managers or Senior Program Managers on complex enterprise projects, special projects or PMO initiatives.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
2 years in a project coordinator or project management role.
Limited travel if located in Baton Rouge, LA or Plano, TX, or Charlotte, NC; travel up to 25% if located elsewhere.
Hands-on experience using project management tools and software.
Experience leading and completing projects according to scope, budget, and timeline.
Experience with scheduling, facilitating, and documenting collaborative small and large group meetings.
Experience with preparing for and presenting to project teams and partners.
Strong organizational skills including attention to detail and time management.
Ability to work under pressure and meet timelines in a fast-paced environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years in a project management role including experience in the Consumer Lending industry.
Experience with Microsoft Project, other project management tools, program and resource management applications.
Working understanding of project management disciplines: Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, etc.

Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package including:

Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance
15 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) to start + 1 additional personal holiday
401k + employer match
Company provided Life Insurance & Long Term Disability
Employee Assistance Program - Confidential mental health support

Additional benefits with Republic Finance include:

Access to LinkedIn Learning's library of 10,000+ professional development courses
Employee of the Month Program
Philanthropic support for multiple charities including an annual drive for St. Jude Children's Research Hospital
Regular drawings for Sports tickets
Professional offices with a friendly team environment

jobs.title: Project Manager-1
jobs.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses (https://www.idexcorp.com/our-businesses/business-segments/) around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

Reports to:
Sr. Director, PMO

Function:
Project Management / Enterprise Execution / Strategic Initiatives

Location:
Remote Based in the US, Preferably in Eastern and Central time zones

Travel:
As needed to support project launches, milestone reviews, business leader working sessions, and implementation activities across the business footprint.

Role Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for leading cross-functional projects that translate strategic priorities into clear, actionable, and measurable execution plans. Reporting to the Sr. Director, PMO, this role will help drive disciplined project execution across the organization by defining project scope, milestones, deliverables, owners, risks, decision points, and success metrics.

This role is designed for a highly resourceful, business-minded project leader who can operate effectively in ambiguity, influence without authority, and move seamlessly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution. The Project Manager will partner closely with business leaders, functional leaders, site teams, and initiative owners to ensure work is prioritized, resourced, governed, and executed with focus and accountability.

The role will support execution of the organization’s critical priorities by building integrated project plans, establishing governance routines, tracking progress, escalating risks, and helping teams make practical trade-offs between competing priorities. The following role profile emphasizes converting strategic priorities into initiatives with clear outcomes, owners, milestones, and operating cadences, and this Project Manager role is intended to bring that same execution discipline to the PMO.

Key Outcomes

Role

Success in this role will be measured by the Project Manager’s ability to create clarity, momentum, and accountability across complex initiatives. Strong performance will be demonstrated when:

Projects have clear charters, objectives, milestones, owners, deliverables, risks, decision points, and measurable outcomes.
Project teams understand what is in scope, what is out of scope, what work must stop or shift, and who owns each key action.
Initiative governance is operating with disciplined cadences, clear escalation paths, and timely decision-making.
Project risks, dependencies, and resource constraints are surfaced early and actively managed.
Stakeholders receive clear, concise, and executive-ready communication on project status, progress, risks, decisions, and next steps.
Projects are connected to business priorities and supported by practical tools, routines, and operating mechanisms that help teams execute consistently.
Teams remain focused on the “critical few” priorities and avoid fragmentation across disconnected workstreams, consistent with the emphasis in the attached document on narrowing priorities, clarifying ownership, and reinforcing execution through operating routines.

Core Responsibilities

Lead Project Planning and Execution

Translate strategic initiatives, business priorities, and functional objectives into integrated project plans with clear deliverables, timelines, milestones, owners, dependencies, and success metrics.
Develop and maintain project plans, workback schedules, risk logs, issue trackers, decision logs, stakeholder maps, and status reporting tools.
Ensure each project has a clearly defined scope, business case, expected outcomes, resource requirements, and governance model.
Drive execution discipline by ensuring project teams understand priorities, timing, decision rights, and accountabilities.
Proactively identify barriers to progress and work with leaders and team members to resolve issues quickly.
Maintain momentum across multiple workstreams while ensuring project teams remain focused on the highest-value activities.

Establish Governance, Cadence, and Accountability

Create and manage project governance routines, including project team meetings, steering committee updates, milestone reviews, decision forums, and escalation processes.
Ensure project progress is visible through consistent reporting, clear metrics, and timely communication.
Track actions, owners, decisions, risks, and dependencies to ensure accountability across the project team.
Escalate risks and decisions appropriately, ensuring leaders have the information needed to make timely and informed decisions.
Help reinforce disciplined operating routines so that project execution is embedded into how leaders manage the business, consistent with the attached document’s emphasis on cadence, governance, decision forums, and escalation paths.

Partner Cross-Functionally to Drive Results

Partner with business leaders, functional leaders, site leaders, and initiative owners to align project work with business priorities.
Coordinate across functions such as Operations, Finance, HR, Commercial, Continuous Improvement, IT, Supply Chain, and other business teams as needed.
Build strong working relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and influence progress without relying on direct authority.
Drive clarity on roles, responsibilities, decision rights, resource needs, and expected outcomes.
Facilitate alignment when priorities compete, information is incomplete, or stakeholders have differing perspectives.
Help leaders and teams make practical trade-offs regarding scope, timing, budget, resources, and value.

Manage Risk, Issues, Dependencies, and Change

Identify project risks, issues, dependencies, resource constraints, and potential execution gaps early.
Develop mitigation plans and partner with stakeholders to remove roadblocks.
Monitor project health and provide fact-based updates on schedule, scope, budget, quality, adoption, and business impact.
Anticipate the operational, financial, organizational, and people-related implications of project decisions.
Support change management activities by helping teams understand what is changing, why it matters, what is expected, and how success will be measured.
Ensure communication is clear, timely, and tailored to the needs of different stakeholder groups.

Support Business Prioritization and Value Creation

Apply strong business and financial acumen to understand how projects support growth, margin improvement, operational performance, productivity, customer outcomes, or organizational effectiveness.
Help teams focus work on the highest-value priorities and reduce effort on lower-value activities.
Use data, metrics, and business insights to inform project decisions, status updates, and recommendations.
Support project prioritization by helping leaders understand resource needs, trade-offs, timing implications, and execution risks.
Where applicable, help connect project work to 80/20 thinking, customer/product priorities, operational routines, and value-creation opportunities, reflecting the attached document’s focus on using 80/20 principles to support simplification, segmentation, profitable growth, and resource allocation.

Communicate with Executive Presence

Prepare clear, concise, and executive-ready project updates, including status summaries, dashboards, decision documents, risk updates, and milestone reports.
Communicate complex project information in a way that is simple, structured, and actionable.
Tailor communication to different audiences, including senior leaders, project sponsors, functional partners, and implementation teams.
Facilitate meetings effectively, ensuring discussions are focused, decisions are captured, owners are assigned, and follow-up actions are completed.
Demonstrate strong leadership presence, sound judgment, and confidence when presenting project updates, raising risks, and recommending solutions.

Build Repeatable PMO Tools and Practices

Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of PMO tools, templates, routines, and project management standards.
Create practical tools that make project execution easier, more consistent, and more transparent for business and functional teams.
Identify opportunities to improve project governance, reporting, decision-making, and execution discipline.
Capture lessons learned and share best practices across projects and teams.
Help build a culture of accountability, action orientation, and disciplined execution.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Human Resources, Organizational Effectiveness, or a related field.
Project management experience leading cross-functional initiatives in a complex, matrixed, or multi-site environment.
Demonstrated ability to build project plans, manage timelines, track milestones, identify risks, and drive accountability.
Experience working with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with the ability to understand operational, financial, organizational, and customer implications of project work.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare executive-ready updates and facilitate decision-making conversations.
Proven ability to influence without authority and drive results through collaboration.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
High comfort level operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists.
Proficiency with project management tools, Microsoft Office applications, and project reporting methods.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in manufacturing, industrial, engineering, operational, commercial, or global business environments.
Experience supporting strategic initiatives, transformation programs, operating model deployment, integration efforts, or enterprise-level business priorities.
Familiarity with business operating rhythms such as goal deployment, daily management, monthly business reviews, or similar management systems.
Experience supporting initiatives tied to 80/20, simplification, segmentation, profitable growth, operational improvement, or resource prioritization.

Working Conditions

Role may require travel to business sites, project launch meetings, milestone reviews, and leadership working sessions.
Must be able to support projects across multiple functions, businesses, and stakeholder groups.
Must be comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with evolving business needs.
Must be able to work effectively in both strategic planning discussions and detailed execution environments.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager based in Brazil.

This role combines technical project leadership with hands-on software development expertise to guide projects from planning through delivery.

You’ll work at the intersection of business requirements and engineering execution, translating needs into clear technical plans and actionable tasks.

The position requires enough technical depth to understand code, architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, and development workflows.

You’ll coordinate developers, designers, QA specialists, and other technical contributors while keeping projects aligned with scope, timelines, and quality standards.

The role also involves identifying risks, resolving blockers, facilitating Agile ceremonies, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.

You’ll contribute directly to technical discussions and decisions rather than operating solely as an administrative project manager.

This is a fully remote opportunity suited to an organized, analytical professional who can combine technical judgment with strong project leadership.

Accountabilities

Lead technical projects through the full lifecycle, from requirements gathering and planning through development, testing, deployment, and post-launch support.
Translate business requirements into clear technical requirements, user stories, specifications, and development tasks.
Create project plans, establish timelines, assign responsibilities, and manage priorities across multiple concurrent projects.
Coordinate developers, designers, QA specialists, and other technical contributors to keep delivery on track.
Review technical solutions and provide informed input on architecture, integrations, database structures, APIs, and development approaches.
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions when required.
Monitor development progress, identify blockers and risks, and work with teams to resolve technical and operational issues.
Facilitate sprint planning, backlog prioritization, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and other Agile activities.
Ensure projects follow appropriate development, testing, documentation, security, and deployment processes.
Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery expectations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Maintain accurate project documentation covering requirements, timelines, technical decisions, dependencies, and status updates.
Support troubleshooting and incident resolution for existing systems when needed.
Identify and implement improvements to project management and software development processes.

Requirements

4+ years of professional software development experience.
2+ years of experience managing technical or software development projects.
Strong hands-on programming experience with one or more languages or frameworks such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Java, C#, React, Node.js, or similar technologies.
Ability to read, understand, review, and discuss code with software developers.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, system architecture, databases, APIs, integrations, version control, testing, and deployment.
Experience managing Agile or Scrum-based development teams.
Experience with project management platforms such as Jira, ClickUp, Monday.com, Asana, or similar tools.
Working knowledge of GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or comparable version-control platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a practical approach to identifying and resolving delivery challenges.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear information for non-technical stakeholders.
Strong organization and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and dependencies.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud is a plus.
Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, application security, and infrastructure management is advantageous.
Experience managing distributed or remote development teams is desirable.
Experience working with external clients and gathering technical requirements is a plus.
Relevant project management or Agile certification is an advantage.

Benefits

Fully remote work arrangement.
Opportunity to combine software development expertise with technical project leadership.
End-to-end ownership of software projects from requirements through deployment and post-launch support.
Direct involvement in technical architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, and development decisions.
Collaboration with developers, designers, QA specialists, and business stakeholders.
Opportunity to improve development processes, documentation, accountability, and delivery practices.
Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern project management and development tools.
Opportunity to work across multiple technical projects and contribute to meaningful delivery improvements.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options | Benefits

Help build the future of customer operations

We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.

We’re looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager
to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.

This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.

What You’ll Do

Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo

You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.

Build strong partnerships at every level

You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.

Drive change, not just delivery

You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets
Manage cross-collective programmes:
Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition
Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery
Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery

Drive effective decision making to remove blockers
Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area

You Should Apply If

You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch
You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences
You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further
You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with
You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail
You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution
You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”
You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.
You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery

You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

What Makes This Role Different

Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.

You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.

You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.

How We Work 💻

Locations & Flexible Working :

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The Interview Process

Recruiter Call (30 mins) You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.
Initial Call (45 mins) You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.
Loop Stage (3 hours) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email tech-hiring@monzo.com

What’s In It For You

💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager REQ_107
jobs.description:
Technical Program Manager

3Pillar Global builds breakthrough software products that power digital businesses. We partner with the world's leading organizations to design, build, and scale software solutions — combining human expertise with AI-driven delivery to achieve outcomes that matter.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will be the operational backbone of our most strategic client engagements. Reporting to a Product Delivery Director you will translate executive-level vision into structured, accountable program execution — owning the full delivery lifecycle from pre-SOW solutioning through to successful client outcomes.

This is not a coordination role. You will be a technical leader, a trusted delivery lead, and a practitioner who understands how modern AI-driven delivery teams operate and where human judgment is irreplaceable.

Key Responsibilities

Lead engagements where AI agents are embedded across the SDLC — from requirements gathering and code generation to testing, documentation, and release management.
Understand where AI drives genuine efficiency gains and where human-in-the-loop oversight is required to maintain quality, compliance, and client trust.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of 3Pillar's AI-driven delivery practices, bringing lessons learned from the field back into our operating model.

Note: 3Pillar operates proprietary delivery frameworks — including our Helix AI human-agent delivery model and our Lightwave Client Engagement SDLC. Candidates will not be expected to know these on day one, but should bring the foundational disciplines and AI-driven delivery experience that enable rapid adoption.

Pre-SOW Solutioning & Scoping

Partner with the Solutioning team to define engagement scope, approach, and solution architecture prior to contract execution.
Contribute to SOW development — translating client requirements into structured delivery commitments with clear assumptions, risks, and effort estimates.
Bring a point of view on how AI-driven delivery can accelerate outcomes and where it introduces risk that must be managed.

Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary day-to-day delivery lead for technical and mid-management stakeholders, building trust through consistent delivery and clear communication.
Facilitate executive-level program governance in support of the Product Delivery Director, ensuring alignment on objectives, risks, and progress.
Proactively surface issues, manage escalations, and maintain client confidence through transparency — especially on fixed-outcome engagements where contractual accountability is high.

Delivery Excellence & Program Execution

Serve as the first line of accountability for delivery success — owning outcome, schedule, quality, and engagement margin, and escalating early when any of the four is at risk.
Own end-to-end program execution across 2–3 concurrent client accounts with typical annual contract values in the $1–2M range, or a single large strategic engagement, depending on scope.
Own the quality bar for everything the engagement ships — accountable for defining what "done" means, enforcing it, and standing behind the result with the client.
Anticipate delivery bottlenecks, manage cross-functional dependencies, and drive issue resolution without waiting to be asked.
Build and maintain delivery mechanisms — cadences, dashboards, escalation paths, and reporting structures — that provide clarity to all stakeholders.
Establish and maintain the human oversight model for AI-generated work: review depth, test coverage expectations, security and compliance checks, and clear sign-off ownership at each stage of the SDLC.
Maintain the contractual thread from SOW through execution, ensuring commitments, assumptions, and dependencies stay visible to both sides and that delivery reality is reconciled against what was sold. Propose and make tradeoffs and communicate them clearly.

Minimum Qualifications

Engineering Foundation. Career trajectory: you started in software engineering or a closely related technical discipline and grew into process and program leadership. We are not looking for career PMs who drifted in from the business side.
10+ Years of Experience: spanning software engineering, technical leadership, and program management — with at least 5 years in a program or delivery leadership role on client-facing or product-facing engagements.
Demonstrated Experience Deploying AI Agents into Delivery Workflows — not just using AI tools, but integrating agents into the SDLC and managing the human oversight model that keeps them productive and accountable.
Clear Understanding of Where AI Drives Efficiency Across the SDLC: and where human judgment, accountability, and oversight are non-negotiable.
Experience on Fixed-Outcome or SOW-Based Engagements: where you owned contractual delivery commitments, not just best-effort project management.
Proven Ability to Manage External Client Relationships: at the technical and mid-management level — building trust through delivery, not just relationship management.
Experience Contributing to Pre-Sales or Pre-SOW Solutioning —: scoping engagements, estimating effort, and shaping delivery approaches before contracts are signed.
Cloud Platform Fluency: Working fluency in at least one major cloud platform — AWS, Azure, or GCP — sufficient to engage credibly on architecture decisions, infrastructure tradeoffs, and cloud-native delivery patterns.
Professional Services Context. Experience delivering in a consulting, agency, or services environment, or as an internal consultant to executive stakeholders — you understand the difference between building a product and delivering an outcome someone bought.
Excellent English language skills, both verbal and written.

Additional Experience Desired:

Experience running multiple concurrent accounts rather than a single engagement.
A track record of bringing field lessons back into an operating model — playbooks, standards, or practices that outlived the engagement that produced them.
Experience using quantitative and qualitative data to inform design decisions and drive change
While we work nearly 100% remote, occasional travel (~2-3x/year) to 3Pillar sites and client locations will be required in this role to support ongoing team and client engagement

What is it like working for 3Pillar Global?

At 3Pillar, We Offer a World Of Opportunity

Imagine a flexible work environment - whether it's the office, your home, or a blend of both. From interviews to onboarding, we embody a remote-first approach.
You will be part of a global team, learning from top talent around the world and across cultures, speaking English everyday. Our global workforce enables our team to leverage global resources to accomplish our work in efficient and effective teams.
We're big on your well-being - as a company, we spend a whole trimester in our annual cycle focused on wellbeing. Whether it is taking advantage of fitness offerings, mental health plans (country-dependent), or simply leveraging generous time off, we want all of our team members operating at their best.
Our professional services model enables us to accelerate career growth and development opportunities - across projects, offerings, and industries.
We are an equal opportunity employer. It goes without saying that we live by values like Intrinsic Dignity and Open Collaboration to create cutting-edge technology AND reinforce our commitment to diversity - globally and locally.

Join us and be a part of a global tech community!

Check out our Linkedin site and Careers page to learn more about what it’s like to be part of our #oneteam!

jobs.description:
Overview

The Infosys Manufacturing unit is at the forefront of revolutionizing the industry with innovative digital solutions. We specialize in transforming client relationships in the Automotive, Aerospace, Defense, and Industrial Manufacturing sectors, driving significant growth and operational excellence. Join us to be part of a team that leverages cutting-edge technology to create sustainable, efficient, and resilient manufacturing processes, making a tangible impact on the global stage.

In the assigned Job Role of Package Project Lead 3, your Area Of Responsibility will be as below:

Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and data-driven decision-making to ensure cohesive project execution and alignment with objectives
Engage with senior stakeholders and executive leadership to define project scope and foster consensus for successful outcomes
Evaluate and refine project management processes by incorporating best practices for improved efficiency and effectiveness
Establish quality benchmarks and implement risk management strategies to enhance project outcomes and mitigate organizational risks
Monitor project margins and ensure alignment between actual performance and financial targets
Develop RFP responses and participate in client discussions to finalize commercial estimates and drive Go-to-Market strategies
Engage in resource allocation, and set performance objectives to align team efforts with project goals
Lead organizational change initiatives and design training roadmaps to ensure smooth adoption of project-driven transformations

Your Contribution To The Team

Strategic leadership in executing Go-to-Market strategies
Specialized in managing large-scale ERP projects with a focus on strategic alignment, resource optimization, and stakeholder collaboration
Proactive planning to align project financials with organizational goals
Expertise in leading organizational change and fostering professional development within teams
Expertise in refining project management methodologies, risk mitigation, and quality assurance
Fostering an inclusive environment that respects diverse backgrounds and perspectives

Required Skill And Experience

SAP project/program management, with a strong focus on supply chain implementations.
Proven experience managing large-scale SAP implementations or S/4HANA transformations.
Experience working with multiple stakeholders across global environments.
Strong knowledge of SAP Supply Chain modules (MM, SD, PP, WM/EWM, etc.).
Deep understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes including procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution.
Familiarity with SAP integration, data migration, and system architecture.
Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills.
Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and cross-functional teams.
Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and project governance.
Ability to translate complex SAP and supply chain concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience in performance matrix and troubleshooting requirements related to internal/external consulting, documenting.
Analytical and Communication skills.
Planning and Co-ordination skills.
Manage freeze periods, emergency changes, retrofit activities and decommissioning of systems during the upgrades and Migrations.

Knowledge of Transport Management concepts and processes.

Preferred Skill And Experience

Delivery Governance & Reporting

Track project progress, KPIs, and milestone achievements.
Provide regular status reports, risk updates, and executive summaries to senior leadership and customer stakeholders.
Establish dashboards and reporting mechanisms for transparent project tracking.
Drive governance, compliance, and quality standards across the project lifecycle.

Customer Engagement

Work closely with customer leadership teams to ensure expectation management and satisfaction.
Support decision-making processes by providing insights and recommendations.
Act as a trusted advisor to customers during SAP transformation initiatives.

Team Leadership

Lead cross-functional teams including SAP functional consultants, technical teams, and third-party vendors.
Mentor and guide project teams to deliver high-quality outcomes.
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Additional Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
This position may require relocation and/or travel to work/project location.
Candidates authorized to work for any employer in the United States without employer-based visa sponsorship are welcome to apply. Infosys is unable to provide immigration sponsorship for this role now or in the future.

Additional Details

Estimated annual compensation range for candidate based in the below locations

CA, WA, NY, CO, MD, IL, MN, NJ, VT, MA,VA

7B $118,000 to $ 174,000

Washington, DC : $ 119,500 to $ 155,000

Benefits

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Infosys employee you are also eligible for the following benefits:

Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
Long-term/Short-term Disability
Health and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts
Insurance (Accident, Critical Illness , Hospital Indemnity, Legal)
401(k) plan and contributions dependent on salary level
Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off

About Us

Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in more than 50 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.

EEO

Infosys provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race; color; sex; gender identity; sexual orientation; religious practices and observances; national origin; pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; status as a protected veteran or spouse/family member of a protected veteran; or disability.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Flume Health

Flume Health is a software company that connects the fragmented healthcare data ecosystem for more efficient health plan administration. As a single, cloud-native integration platform, Flume’s Relay platform allows companies to easily connect various systems and vendors for efficient data exchange that’s increasingly demanded of the modern health plan. Payers, third-party administrators, prescription benefits managers, and health solutions are provided the simplicity, speed, and security they need to automate data integration and movement between relevant stakeholders. Relay supports multiple data transmission protocols, data types, and file types. By streamlining data flows between payers and solutions, a world of opportunity exists to improve access to healthcare.

Flume Health is hiring a Forward Deployed Program Manager to own program and integration delivery and solve complex client problems across our portfolio, with a primary focus on our largest accounts. You are the person who sits at the intersection of client needs, data integration complexity, and AI-powered execution. You figure out how to get things done, unblock delivery, and drive outcomes.

What makes this role different: you will build, manage, and continuously tune a team of AI agents that solve complete problems end-to-end. Diagnosing why a connection is failing, generating client-ready deliverables, automating workflows that used to take days. You are responsible for agent performance: refining prompts, improving outputs, expanding what your agents can handle, and pushing the boundary of what one person with AI leverage can deliver.

This role requires a consulting mindset: the ability to walk into ambiguity, structure the problem, mobilize resources (human and AI), and deliver. You will manage the program and integration delivery cadence, but more importantly, you will be the person clients call when something is hard and needs to get figured out.

This is not a traditional project management role. This is an execution-oriented position with a clear progression path into Flume's Forward Deployment and Strategic Deployment practice, where you will own client engagements that drive platform transformation and measurable business outcomes for health payers and TPAs.

What You'll Do

Client Problem-Solving:** Be the person who figures it out. When a TPA integration is failing, when a client has a data question no one can answer, when a new connection request requires scoping and creative problem-solving. You own it. Structure the problem, mobilize resources, and deliver.
AI Agent Management & Tuning:** Build, manage, and continuously improve a team of AI agents. You own agent performance. That means refining prompts, evaluating outputs, expanding agent capabilities, and tuning workflows to solve increasingly complex problems across integration diagnostics, client deliverables, reporting automation, intake processing, and data analysis.
Program & Integration Delivery Ownership:** Own the delivery cadence for our flagship account (80+ contracted connections) and a portfolio of secondary accounts. Manage the Jira intake workflow, ensure requirements are captured cleanly, and drive work through the build pipeline
Client-Facing Escalation:** Serve as the primary operational POC for key client IT and Business Operations stakeholders. Attend leadership calls, surface blockers early, and ensure delivery commitments are met.
Stakeholder Communication:** Own weekly delivery reporting to senior client stakeholders. Use AI to generate it, not your weekends
Cross-Account Coverage:** Provide problem-solving support across the broader client portfolio as needed, including delivery troubleshooting, integration scoping, and contract coordination.

What You'll Need

5+ years in consulting, implementation, or healthcare operations:** You've been the person in the room who has to figure out a hard problem with incomplete information and deliver under pressure. Strategy consulting, management consulting, implementation, or similar client-facing delivery experience.
AI-native (required):** This is non-negotiable. You build agents, tune them, measure their output quality, and expand their scope over time. You don't just use AI to summarize emails. You think in terms of what a team of well-tuned agents can do, not what you can do alone.
Client-facing confidence:** You can sit in a daily technology leadership call with senior client stakeholders and field hard questions without flinching. You're comfortable being the single point of contact when things get complicated.
Structured thinker:** You walk into ambiguity and create clarity. You break down complex integration problems into workable pieces and drive them to resolution.
Low ego, high throughput:** You're willing to do the operational work well because you understand it's the foundation for everything strategic. No task is beneath you if it moves the client forward.
Healthcare exposure preferred, not required:** If you've worked with payers, providers, claims data, or health plan operations, great. If not, you're sharp enough to ramp fast.

Nice to Haves

Experience building, tuning, and measuring AI agent workflows to solve multi-step business problems
Background in strategy consulting, management consulting, or implementation delivery at a professional services firm
Familiarity with TPA operations, claims processing, healthcare EDI, or health plan administration
Experience with Jira, Snowflake, or healthcare data integration platforms
Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage environment where scope evolves quickly

Salary

$130k - $160k + equity

Flume’s Perks & Benefits

Flexible PTO - you’re going to be working hard so enjoy time off
A robust stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in Flume’s success
WFH stipend - we’ve always been remote first
Competitive compensation and 401k with a 4% match
Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision)

jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Leica Microsystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Shape the Future with Us!

At Leica Microsystems, we have been shaping the future for over 175 years with groundbreaking optical and digital solutions. With a culture rooted in customer focus, innovation, and teamwork, we lead the market in microscopy, imaging, and analysis, unveiling the invisible and empowering our customers to build a better, healthier world.

Joining Leica Microsystems means contributing to scientific discoveries and supporting surgeons in making critical decisions. jobs.title: Data Transparency Project Manager (EHDS)
jobs.description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Sub Function

Data Governance & Policy

Job Category

Professional

All Job Posting Locations:

High Wycombe, Buckinghamshire, United Kingdom

Job Description

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow. Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

We are searching for the best talent for a Director, European Health Data Space (EHDS) Programme Management
within our Clinical Data Transparency business. The position may be located Beerse, Belgium; Leiden, the Netherlands; High Wycombe/Maidenhead, UK; Allschwil, Switzerland; or Spring House / Titusville / Raritan, United States.
The position is Hybrid (3 days onsite weekly). Remote work options may be considered on a case-by-case basis and if approved by the company.

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):

United Kingdom- Requisition Number: R-100003

Belgium, Netherlands- Requisition Number: R-101024

United States - Requisition Number: R-101030

Switzerland - Requisition Number: R-101027

Remember, whether you apply to one or all of these requisition numbers, your applications will be considered as a single submission.

Position Summary

The Director provides strategic and operational leadership for Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine's European Health Data Space (EHDS) programme. Reporting to the Head of Clinical Data Standards & Transparency, IDAR, the role is accountable for defining and delivering the EHDS strategy, governance, operating model, and implementation roadmap, translating evolving regulatory requirements into sustainable business capabilities.

The Director leads a complex, cross-functional programme spanning Global Development, Legal, Privacy, Regulatory Affairs, Technology, Data Transparency, MedTech, and other business functions. Through matrix leadership, the role drives alignment, manages enterprise-wide dependencies, enables decision-making, and provides leadership with visibility of progress, risks, resources, and key decisions.

Dedicated to EHDS, the role may also support closely related Clinical Data Transparency priorities to ensure successful implementation and long-term adoption of EHDS capabilities.

You Will Be Responsible For

Sets the program management strategy and integrated delivery approach for EHDS, ensuring alignment between regulatory requirements, business priorities, technology enablement, and operational readiness.
Leads the integrated program plan, roadmap, milestones, outcomes, and success measures across Regulation Monitoring, Strategy Setting, Operating Model Design, Technology Enablement, Data Inventory and Cataloging, change management, and program governance.
Directs program execution across workstreams, establishes clear accountability for outcomes, and ensures delivery remains aligned to agreed scope, quality, compliance, resources, and priorities.
Establishes and oversees program governance, including decision rights, escalation pathways, integrated reporting, and the management of actions, risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
Advises the EHDS Implementation Lead and senior governance bodies on program direction, delivery options, trade-offs, material risks, resource needs, and decisions required.
Navigates a complex stakeholder landscape, drives alignment on scope, requirements, priorities, and sequencing, and enables clear communication between leadership, workstream leads, business functions, and technology teams.
Anticipates and manages strategic and operational risks, dependencies, delivery constraints, and competing priorities; drives proactive mitigation and resolution and advances material matters through the appropriate governance pathways.
Directs resource and capacity planning across the program, including demand, allocation, external support, investment requirements, and the transition of capabilities into sustainable internal ownership.
Ensures technology-related activity is integrated with business requirements and operating processes, while maintaining clear accountability between business owners and technology delivery teams.
Defines and leads all aspects of the program change strategy, including impact assessment, engagement, communications, training, readiness, adoption, and transition to business-as-usual operations.
Oversees program performance, develops meaningful measures and insights, and uses them to identify corrective action, strengthen delivery rigor, and improve program efficiency.
Leads the development of executive materials and concise program reporting that provides visibility of delivery status, upcoming decisions, risks, interdependencies, and required leadership action.
Provides direction to external advisors, vendors, and communications partners; ensures deliverables, performance, and contractual expectations are aligned with program objectives.
Represents J&J on EHDS program delivery matters with relevant external bodies, industry groups, and partners, as required and in coordination with the appropriate subject matter experts.
Builds program management capability by establishing fit-for-purpose methods, tools, templates, and ways of working that can be sustained as EHDS requirements evolve.
If assigned direct reports, is accountable for hiring, development, coaching, performance management, and succession planning. Where the role operates as an individual contributor, provides functional direction, mentoring, and matrix leadership to program colleagues.

Are you ready to join our team? then please read further!

Education And Experience Requirements

Advanced degree in a scientific, technology, healthcare, or business discipline, or equivalent experience.
At least 10 years of relevant pharmaceutical, healthcare, technology, or scientific experience, including substantial leadership of large, complex, cross-functional programs!
Demonstrated ability to set program direction, establish governance, lead execution, and deliver outcomes across multiple functions in a global matrix environment.
Expert program and portfolio management capability, including integrated planning, risk and dependency management, resource planning, change, executive reporting, and decision governance.
Formal project or program management certification, such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or SAFe, is preferred.
Working knowledge of the EU regulatory environment and data-related obligations; familiarity with EHDS, GDPR, clinical trial transparency, data governance, or regulated technology implementation is strongly preferred.
Ability to influence and negotiate with senior stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and enable decisions where requirements and delivery pathways continue to evolve.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate regulatory and technical complexity into clear program choices, plans, and executive-level messages.
Demonstrated leadership in problem solving, critical thinking, prioritization, and decision making.
Experience leading people, senior individual contributors, vendors, or multidisciplinary teams.
Some domestic or international travel may be required.

Benefits

We offer a competitive salary and extensive benefits package. The health and well-being of our employees is a priority, we have a flexible working environment as we value work-life balance. We offer career development opportunities for those who want to grow and be part of our organisation. For additional general information on company benefits, please go to: https://www.careers.jnj.com/employee-benefits

Required Skills

People Leadership, Portfolio Management, Program Management

Preferred Skills

Advanced Analytics, Agile Methodology, Continuous Improvement, Database Management, Data Governance, Data Management, Data Privacy Standards, Data Savvy, Data Security, Data Stewardship, Emerging Technologies, Information Security Risk Management, Leadership, Performance Measurement, Strategic Thinking, Tactical Planning, Technical Credibility

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - AI Applications, Enterprise Intelligence
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The Enterprise Intelligence (EI) team harnesses the power of data to deliver transformative insights and solutions to EA game teams and players. EI teams are involved in every aspect of data, driving strategy and governance; building powerful data and AI applications; and developing personalization, experimentation, analytics tools, and more. When you join EI, you're joining a team of passionate experts working to enable more profound understanding, better ways of working, and more meaningful experiences for our players. Within EI, the AI Applications (AIA) team focuses on building and scaling AI-driven products and capabilities that unlock deeper insights, accelerate decision-making, and enable intelligent, data-informed outcomes across EA.

As a Technical Program Manager, AI Applications, you will report to the Director, Technical Program Management - Engineering Operations. You will play a critical role in translating AI Applications strategy into execution across programs that span global teams, including Austin and Hyderabad. These initiatives focus on advancing AI/ML solutions, scaling data and insights platforms, and embedding AI capabilities into enterprise workflows.

You will operate across both program and team execution, leading Agile delivery practices while also managing cross-functional programs end-to-end. You will ensure alignment across stakeholders, drive execution rigor, and partner closely with AI Applications leadership to establish scalable planning, reporting, and execution practices that enable teams to deliver high-impact AI and data solutions within the AI Applications organization.

Responsibilities

You will manage end-to-end program execution, including scope definition, milestones, dependencies, risks, success measures, and delivery across AI Applications initiatives.
You will establish and facilitate Agile and program operating rhythms for globally distributed teams, including quarterly and sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and backlog management.
You will partner with AI Applications leadership, Engineering Operations leadership, Product Management, cross-functional teams across EI, and business stakeholders to align strategic priorities, ownership, and delivery outcomes.
You will drive program-level planning, including capacity planning, resource allocation, OKRs, and roadmap alignment across Austin and Hyderabad teams, and contribute to annual and quarterly planning cycles and recurring leadership reporting.
You will manage budgets, resourcing plans, and external/vendor partnerships to support program delivery.
You will identify, track, and mitigate risks and issues, ensuring transparency and proactive resolution.
You will provide clear, concise, and data-driven updates to leadership, surfacing progress, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and recommendations to enable informed decision-making.
You will identify and implement opportunities to improve program delivery and team operating practices, increasing organizational effectiveness and predictability as AI Applications scales.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience in technical program management supporting complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Experience working with global teams across multiple time zones (e.g., US and India)
Strong expertise in Agile methodologies and experience establishing effective planning and execution rhythms for technical teams.
Experience working within data, AI/ML, analytics, or insights-driven organizations.
Proven ability to manage capacity planning, budgets, and resourcing strategies.

Your career opportunity

Join Group Business Solutions (GBS), Euroclear’s technology division, to lead a business-critical transformation at the heart of Euroclear Bank’s cash services.

Euroclear is restarting the Cash Modernisation programme, a strategic, multi-year transformation of one of its most critical end-to-end business services. jobs.description:
Company Description

Arista Networks
is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.

Job Description

Who You’ll Work With:

Arista is seeking a Hardware Technical Program Manager. This is a critical role, ensuring that Arista customer driven programs complete milestone deliverables to meet the customer’s needs and prevent delays to their internal development and deployment programs. As a Technical Program Manager you will work directly with experienced internal cross-disciplinary engineering team leaders, customers, and strategic partners to drive hardware product development from planning, design, validation, qualification, through release to volume production. You will lead the cross-functional engineering team through the NPI product lifecycle phases and the associated design and phase gate reviews. Strong leadership, communications, problem solving, and communication skills are essential.

What You’ll Do

Specific Duties and Responsibilities:

Creating statement of work (SoW) and product requirement documents (PRD) for complex technical programs
Owns and facilitates weekly cross-functional engineering team meetings.
Interface with key customers and strategic partners to develop program plans including negotiating schedules, milestone deliverables, prototype allocations, and feature set.
Lead a cross-functional team from HW, SW, Central, and Diagnostic engineering, manufacturing engineering, product management, ODM/JDM partners, and customer support to deliver outstanding products to the market.
You will be responsible for tracking and reporting on the cross-functional design engineering validation, and qualification status of your programs, as well as identifying and solving any concerns prior to them causing impact.
Create a master schedule that captures and inter-connects the key cross-functional deliverables as defined by the product development lifecycle and ensure the team stays on track to meet program milestones.
Lead program design review and bug scrub meetings
Identify risks on program planning and actively work on mitigation plan with all stake holders
Drive, coordinate, and monitor engineering programs including scheduling, planning, product and project cost analysis, and milestone checkpoint reviews.
Drive cross-functional issue resolution ensuring issues are identified, assigned owners, and tracked to closure. Ensure issues are escalated to the appropriate functional leaders.
Facilitate engineering portion of phase gate review meetings

Qualifications

10+ years of NPI hardware engineering and leadership experience
Design engineering, New Product Introduction, and manufacturing experience with rack-mounted data center or enterprise equipment
Experience working with multiple engineering disciplines including electrical, mechanical, software, diagnostics, test, and manufacturing engineering team members
Exceptional project management skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication and organizational skills.
Significant working knowledge of hardware development.
Proven track record of managing hardware projects and delivering on time.
Demonstrated ability to take initiative, define, document, implement new processes.
Experience interfacing with product management, internal cross-functional engineering teams, and sub-tier suppliers
Ability to listen and simplify complex topics for non-technical audiences, and prepare summaries for executives and stakeholders.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electronics and communication, industrial engineering or equivalent experience. MS/MBA and PMP are desirable.

Additional Information

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.
