Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is looking for a APAC Supply Chain Security Manager to own and lead supply chain security across the Asia-Pacific region. This is one of the most significant and wide-ranging roles within the NGSCS structure, a rare opportunity to build a regional security function from scratch in one of the world's most strategically important and operationally complex logistics markets.

APAC represents a developing and rapidly expanding operational theatre for Nebius. The person in this role will be the sole NGSCS presence in the region, carrying full accountability for all supply chain security operations across APAC, spanning both warehouse and transportation security, across a geographically vast, multi-jurisdictional, and commercially diverse environment. From high-growth logistics hubs like Singapore to emerging markets across Southeast Asia and beyond, this role demands a security professional who can operate with full ownership, sound judgment, and entrepreneurial drive.

Based in Singapore, the natural gateway to APAC logistics operations, this individual will establish the regional security framework, build the vendor and partner ecosystem, define the risk profile across key markets, and deliver operational security outcomes from day one. They will serve as the NGSCS authority for all things APAC, working in close alignment with global leadership while operating with the independence required to get things done in a complex and fast-moving regional environment.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Regional Function Establishment

Build the NGSCS APAC security function from the ground up, establishing the operational framework, regional risk profile, and partner ecosystem required to secure Nebius supply chain operations across the region
Define and implement regional adaptations of global NGSCS security standards, ensuring they are operationally effective across diverse APAC markets and jurisdictions
Identify, assess, and onboard regional security vendors, guarding providers, logistics partners, and technology platforms in alignment with NGSCS requirements
Map and assess the APAC supply chain security landscape, identifying key threat vectors, market-specific risks, and operational vulnerabilities across the region
Establish NGSCS's presence and authority across the APAC vendor and logistics partner network, setting clear expectations for security performance from the outset

Warehouse Security

Own and lead warehouse security across all APAC facilities, with full accountability for facility-level risk and performance
Ensure the secure storage, handling, and integrity of high-value assets across all warehouse and staging facilities in the region
Establish and enforce security requirements across logistics partners operating warehouse and storage facilities, including 3PLs and co-located vendors across APAC markets
Manage physical security standards across facilities, including access control, CCTV, guard force oversight, and alarm systems
Conduct and oversee facility security assessments and audits, benchmarking against TAPA FSR and NGSCS standards
Lead end-to-end response to warehouse security incidents (e.g., theft, loss, unauthorized access, inventory discrepancies), including coordination, investigation, and resolution

Transportation Security

Own and lead transportation security across all APAC shipment lanes, with full accountability for in-transit risk and performance
Ensure the secure handling, packaging, and movement of high-value assets across all transportation nodes within the APAC region
Establish and enforce security requirements across transportation partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, and last-mile delivery providers across APAC markets
Conduct risk assessments across transportation routes, handoff points, and carrier operations, and implement effective mitigation strategies
Manage GPS tracking, geofencing, and real-time monitoring of assets across active regional shipments
Lead end-to-end response to in-transit security incidents (e.g., theft, loss, diversion, tampering), including coordination, investigation, and resolution

Regional Leadership & Global Coordination

Serve as the sole NGSCS authority and escalation point for all supply chain security matters across APAC
Maintain close alignment with the Global Transportation Security Manager and NGSCS global leadership, providing regular visibility into regional performance, risks, and developments
Provide structured intelligence on emerging threats, regulatory changes, and logistics security developments across APAC markets to inform global NGSCS strategy
Monitor and report on regional security performance, risks, and incidents across both warehouse and transportation domains
Drive continuous improvement of regional security capabilities as the APAC function matures, the vendor network develops, and the Nebius operational footprint grows

Operational Scope

Full regional ownership of all supply chain security operations across APAC, warehouse and transportation as the sole NGSCS presence in the region. Note: Taiwan operations are managed separately under a dedicated NGSCS Taiwan role and fall outside the scope of this position
Initial scope covers the current APAC operational footprint, with accountability expanding in line with Nebius's growth across the region
Engagement across a wide range of APAC markets, logistics environments, and regulatory jurisdictions
Significant regional travel required across APAC markets for facility assessments, vendor engagement, route reviews, and incident response
Based in Singapore, operating as the regional hub for NGSCS APAC activity

We Expect You To Have

Significant experience in supply chain security, logistics security, or a combined warehouse and transportation security role
Proven operational experience across the APAC region, with strong understanding of local logistics, regulatory, and security environments across multiple markets
Demonstrated experience building or establishing a security function, team, or regional operational presence in a new or emerging market
Strong experience across both warehouse and facility security and in-transit transportation security operations
Demonstrated experience leading incident response across warehouse and transportation security events in complex, multi-jurisdiction environments
High degree of independence, ownership, and entrepreneurial drive — comfortable creating structure and making sound judgments in ambiguous situations
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across internal leadership and external partners spanning multiple cultures, languages, and business environments
Analytical and structured approach to risk assessment, problem-solving, and regional threat profiling
Fluent English (spoken and written); proficiency in an additional APAC language is preferred

It Will Be An Added Bonus If You Have

Experience in high-value or critical infrastructure supply chain security across APAC (e.g., AI hardware, data centers, semiconductors, electronics)
Background in law enforcement, military, or corporate security with significant APAC regional exposure
Familiarity with TAPA FSR, TAPA TSR, or equivalent supply chain security standards
Familiarity with supply chain security technologies (e.g., GPS tracking, geofencing, access control systems, CCTV, tamper-evident sealing, real-time monitoring platforms)
Deep understanding of logistics and regulatory environments across key APAC markets, including Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Japan and South Korea
Experience working within a global organization with cross-regional coordination requirements

This is a pioneering, high-ownership role. The successful candidate will thrive in an environment that is being defined in real time and will take pride in building something of lasting operational significance
Full dual-domain responsibility across warehouse and transportation security requires strong personal organization and the ability to manage multiple concurrent operational priorities
Security incidents across either domain may require availability and response outside standard working hours
Operates within a global NGSCS environment requiring regular coordination across multiple time zones, including teams in the EU, USA, Israel, and Taiwan

Supported by the Global Transportation Security Manager and NGSCS global leadership, with clear and full ownership of all supply chain security outcomes across the APAC region

jobs.description:
DE&S Ashchurch, Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire GL20 8LZ

Job Summary

At Defence Equipment & Support (DE&S), we supply and maintain vital equipment and services for the Royal Navy, British Army and Royal Air Force. Together, we deliver a vast range of essential defence programmes, and strive for what's next. Because it helps keep our military at the top of their game and our nation safe – for today, and tomorrow.

DE&S has recently been integrated into the National Armaments Director (NAD) Group. The NAD Group brings together key Ministry of Defence (MOD) organisations to unite expertise across science, technology, procurement, infrastructure, and support to provide integrated capabilities faster and more efficiently for our armed forces and our allies. This is an exciting new opportunity to enable better ways of working and empower greater collaboration across Defence. For further information about the NAD Group, please visit: National Armaments Director Group - GOV.UK

We offer 25+ days’ holiday, flexible and hybrid working, enhanced parental leave schemes, shopping discounts, and an exceptional employer pension contribution of 28.97%, to help make work work for you.

Nationality, visas and vetting: For security reasons this role is open to sole UK nationals only.] [A ‘sole UK national’ refers to an individual who holds citizenship solely in the UK, without dual citizenship or nationality from another country. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship.

This role requires you to have lived in the UK for the last 5 years and obtain Security Check (SC) security clearance. Clearance must be obtained without any caveats that prevent you from carrying out the role you’ve been recruited for. If it isn’t obtained, or is obtained but with caveats that prevent you from carrying out the role, any conditional offer made to you will be withdrawn. Obtaining SC security clearance can be a lengthy process, and we reserve the right to withdraw any conditional offer made if the necessary security clearance isn’t obtained within 12 months.

Job Description

The role of a Physical Security Operations Manager is to ensure the correct posture of physical and tactical resources to manage sites and maintain operational preparedness for security incidents.

We are currently looking for an Establishment Security Officer (ESyO) to join the NADG Non-Explosives Sites Team (NEST) general management group at MOD Ashchurch, with the responsibility of MOD Ludgershall. Our security professionals play a vital role part in assessing, evaluating and implementing security policy and strategy within Project Teams, NADG Establishments and the wider Defence Industry community. You will have primary responsibility for the physical security and integrity of the whole site and will be required to work closely with multiple stakeholders and establishment lodger units in supporting and enabling security policy and procedures. Your main duties will include regular monitoring, audits and self-inspections of all aspects of physical security, creating/maintaining mandated site security policies and assisting the wider NEST security teams.

The successful candidate will be expected to attend the MOD Establishment Security Officers Course and Business Continuity training (residential and on-line) and could eventually become a member of the Security Institute.

Candidate would be responsible for Ludgershall site.

We champion flexible ways of working. Regular in-person attendance is required (this is expected to be approximately 60% of your working week) to promote the benefits of face-to-face collaboration alongside flexibility of hours to support work-life balance and business need. You will be expected to travel from Ashchurch to Ludgershall at least once a month to undertake perimeter and building security checks, therefore a full UK driving licence would be beneficial. Initially, you may be expected to attend more frequently to familiarise yourselves with the site, the team, and your role.

What You’ll Be Doing

Providing SME advice at the appropriate organisational level on how to deliver proportional, practical security outcomes, within the parameters set by relevant regulation, policy and procedures and advise on any residual risk.
Create and maintain mandated site security documentation (e.g. Site Security Instructions, Site Security Risk Register, Business Continuity Plans, Site Recovery Plan).
Maintain physical security operations and governance structures to manage risk and deploy physical security effectively to protect assets and people across the business area.
Plan, test and respond to security/emergency incidents or concerns, including those raised by third parties, to include preparing briefs on security issues for internal and external stakeholders.
Comply with relevant internal and external security regulation and legislation and ensure these are adhered to by all staff, contractors and site visitors.
Receive and investigate all submitted incident/occurrence reports.
Maintain an up-to-date understanding of security fundamentals and the current threats to Defence assets.
Liaison with local emergency services and Counter Terrorist Security Advisor (CTSA) to understand the current threats and trends affecting the landscape and how to mitigate against them.
Promote protective security, educating personnel on the threat and providing SME advice to others.
Carry out other Head of Establishment team activities/responsibilities to support additional site outputs as tasked.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Experience navigating a knowledge base and following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

jobs.description:
The Data Analyst
is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:

Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.

Our Ideal Candidate will possess:

2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.

What this role is not:

Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.

NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider

jobs.description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era.
Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen
Relay’s Mission is
to free commerce from friction
. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people
, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM

• ~110 people
, more than half
in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees
across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands
of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking
, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity

Relay’s Last Mile network runs on couriers - tens of thousands of them, doing real work in the physical world every day. Whether each parcel gets delivered successfully depends on the decisions and behaviours of the courier on route. We're hiring for a Senior Data Analyst to own how Relay measures and improves courier excellence: how we shape what happens on the doorstep, and how we manage performance before and after that interaction.
This role works with the whole of the Last Mile team and partners closely with data scientists, engineers and operators across the squad. There's a v1 of performance management already running; you'll own its evolution into something materially better.

Last Mile

Handover Optimisation:
Every handover is a trade-off between competing outcomes - speed, quality, and risk. Moving any one of them can have knock-on effects on the others, and finding the right balance is one of the most interesting analytical problems in the network. Your job is to make those trade-offs visible, model them, and find the levers that move the network in the right direction. You'll run the experiments, design the measurement, and quantify what actually works.
Performance Management:
Relay already has a framework for measuring courier performance, and it feeds into how work is distributed. The job now is to ensure it drives fleet quality - defining the right behaviours to measure, evaluating the interventions designed to help couriers shift those behaviours, and closing the loop so the framework continuously improves. You'll partner with product, ops and engineering across this work, with the analytics owned by you.
Courier-facing analytics:
Couriers are the end users of much of this work. You'll think about how performance and rewards are made transparent to them, and you'll run experiments to evaluate whether interventions are actually working for couriers and for Relay.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You're a strong analyst who thinks in systems. You break complex problems into components and know where the real opportunity lies.
You are successful working with high autonomy and are excited to operate in a Product/Programme Manager like capacity, defining the roadmap as well as executing against it.
You care about solving the problem more than which techniques you use.
You love working with smart, motivated people.
You're fluent in SQL.
You're comfortable across the analytical spectrum - designing and reading experiments, building risk scores and segmentation, and shipping descriptive analysis that drives a decision the same week.
You communicate inclusively with non-technical team members.
You love seeing the impact of your work play out in a daily operation.
Bonus: You have experience working on performance management, marketplace quality, operational analytics or another relevant domain.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.
Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.
25 days of holidays
Enhanced parental leave.
Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.
Hardware of your choice.
Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

Who Thrives at Relay?

Aim with Precision:
You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.
Play to Win:
You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.
1% Better Every Day
: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.
All In, All the Time
: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.
People-Powered Greatness
: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.
Grow the Whole Pie
: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

This is an exciting opportunity to join our Data & Digital team as a Data Analyst, helping organisations turn data into meaningful insights that drive operational and strategic decision-making. You'll work with a range of stakeholders to understand business challenges, analyse complex data and deliver clear, actionable reporting that supports better outcomes across government, defence and highly regulated environments.

Whether your experience has been gained through business intelligence, reporting, analytics or data-focused delivery roles, you'll have the opportunity to develop your skills while working on impactful projects. If you're passionate about solving problems, uncovering insights and helping organisations make evidence-based decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

Gather, cleanse, validate and transform data from multiple internal and external sources to support reporting and analysis requirements
Create, develop and maintain reports, dashboards and visualisations using Power BI, Tableau or equivalent reporting tools
Apply analytical techniques to identify trends, patterns, anomalies and opportunities for improvement.
Produce regular and ad hoc analysis to answer business questions and support decision-making
Write efficient SQL queries to extract, manipulate, validate and analyse data from structured and semi-structured sources
Support the creation and maintenance of performance measures, KPIs and management information reporting
Document analytical methodologies, assumptions, calculations, definitions and data sources
Present findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Support data quality, governance and information management activities to ensure trusted and reliable reporting
Work collaboratively within agile, multidisciplinary delivery teams to deliver analytical outputs
Assist in identifying opportunities to improve reporting, processes and analytical capabilities
Communicate progress, risks and insights effectively with project teams, stakeholders and clients

What's In It For You

Work on meaningful data and analytics projects that support critical services and organisations across the UK
Develop expertise in data analysis, reporting, visualisation and business intelligence tools
Gain hands-on experience working with large and complex datasets across diverse client environments
Collaborate with experienced analysts, engineers, architects and business stakeholders
Build your technical capabilities across SQL, Power BI, Tableau and modern analytics practices
Access mentoring, knowledge sharing and professional development opportunities to support your career growth.
Contribute to data-driven solutions that deliver measurable business value and positive outcomes
Progress through clearly defined technical and professional development pathways as your experience grows

Benefits

A global network of expertise and opportunity
A culture founded on safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging
Flexible working arrangements that support your well-being and potential
Investment in your development through training, certifications and access to experienced mentors
Opportunities to contribute to communities of practice and internal data and analytics initiatives
Exposure to a variety of projects, sectors and analytical challenges
Competitive benefits package including pension, holiday allowance and additional perks
An inclusive environment where diverse perspectives, backgrounds and experiences are valued and encouraged

We welcome applications from candidates with varied backgrounds and experiences. If you don't meet every requirement listed but believe you can bring value to the role, we encourage you to apply.

Strong SQL skills, including joins, filtering, aggregation and data validation techniques.
Experience creating dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau or equivalent visualisation tools.
Advanced Excel skills for analysis, reporting and data manipulation.
Experience cleansing, reconciling and validating data from multiple sources.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, root causes and actionable insights.

At Burberry, we believe creativity opens spaces. Our purpose is to unlock the power of imagination to push boundaries and open new possibilities for our people, our customers and our communities. As a purposeful, values-driven brand, we are committed to being a force for good in the world as well, creating the next generation of sustainable luxury for customers, driving industry change and championing our communities.

Job Purpose:

We are looking for a high-potential candidate to join the Decision Analytics team, a part of the wider Data & Analytics team. We are an award-winning team (DataIQ Awards 2023, 2024 & 2025) and work as an enterprise function, providing analytical support across many business areas including: commercial, customer, merchandising, marketing and platform.
You’ll make the most of a modern, well-supported data stack, utilising leading technology in the field – Databricks, Looker, and Snowplow.  You’ll find yourself in a team that delivers tangible analytical value to the business and is passionate about training and development. Finally, you’ll be working on a global scale but in a company small enough that everyone can have their voice heard and make a difference.
We are recruiting a Data Analyst to join us.

Responsibilities:

Customer & Commercial Analytics: analyse customer behaviour, journeys, and commercial performance to identify opportunities and explain changes in business performance.
Insight Delivery: you’ll be directly responsible for extracting, manipulating and interpreting the wealth of information available to elevate your stakeholders beyond BAU reporting, allowing them to make decisions from a position of knowledge.
Marketing: extend your knowledge of online & offline marketing to analyse campaigns, customer touchpoints and behaviour; understanding how different channels influence commercial trade.
Clickstream: become an expert in clickstream and behavioural data, so you can support our main stakeholders in understanding our digital journey and its value to the business.
Subject Matter Expertise: you must be experienced with analytical methods, utilising and further developing knowledge of techniques such as cohort analysis, customer segmentation, experimentation, applying appropriate approaches with support from the wider team.
Delivery Management: value-led prioritisation of your work and ensuring excellence in day-to-day operational and project delivery.
Stakeholder Collaboration: work with stakeholders to understand their challenges, share insights confidently and progressively take ownership of analytical work.

Personal Profile:

Analytical curiosity and problem-solving: able to explore data, ask the right questions and break ambiguous problems into clear analytical steps.
Strong communication and influencing skills: able to explain insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders and tailor recommendations to the audience.
Collaborative working style: confident working with others, building credibility with stakeholders and valuing different perspectives.
Creative and commercial thinking: brings new ideas, shows interest in technology and focuses on delivering meaningful business value.
Ownership and prioritisation: able to manage time effectively, work independently and communicate delivery timelines clearly.
Growth mindset: motivated to keep developing technical, commercial and business knowledge, including new tools and analytical approaches.

Required Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative, scientific, engineering or related discipline.
Strong SQL or data querying skills, with hands-on experience querying, manipulating and validating datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving foundations, with the ability to investigate questions, identify patterns and draw evidence-based conclusions.
Experience delivering data-led analysis or deep-dive investigations on complex topics, working independently and collaboratively to shape clear recommendations.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical audiences.
Experience with BI or data visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI is beneficial.
Exposure to clickstream data, segmentation, cohort analysis, experimentation, forecasting, statistical analysis, commerce, digital or marketing technology is advantageous but not essential.

The Business & Strategy Analytics team's mission is to transform data into strategic insights that empower our leaders to make informed decisions, effectively track progress, and unlock growth opportunities. Through deep metric understanding, holistic business views, and detailed analytics, we enable concrete actions that drive business success.

Working closely with the Director of FP&A, CFO, and senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Data, you’ll support strategic planning, fundraising, and Preply’s journey toward IPO through rigorous, business-focused analytics.

What you’ll be doing

Lead end-to-end analytical initiatives, translating ambiguous business questions into executive-ready recommendations and measurable business impact.
Develop forecasting models, scenario analyses, driver-based models, and opportunity sizing to evaluate strategic decisions and quantify financial impact.
Connect Product, Marketing, and Operational initiatives with business performance, identifying the key drivers behind revenue, profitability, and efficiency.
Conduct deep dives into business performance to uncover growth opportunities, operational improvements, and emerging risks.
Partner across Finance, Product, Marketing, Operations, and the Data Chapter to establish a trusted, consistent view of business performance and key metrics.
Continuously improve analytical frameworks, business metrics, and decision-support models that enable scalable, data-informed decision making.

What You Need To Succeed

5+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Growth Analytics, Financial Analytics, or a similar analytical role.
Strong SQL skills and confidence independently working with large, complex datasets.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence VP and C-level stakeholders.
Strong analytical and critical thinking, with the ability to simplify complex business problems into actionable insights.
Proven experience building forecasting models, scenario analyses, financial impact models, and driver-based analyses.
Experience leading cross-functional analytical initiatives from problem definition through implementation.
Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
A proactive, curious mindset with strong business intuition and a focus on pragmatic problem solving.
Familiarity with AI tools that improve analytical productivity and decision-making.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets modeling skills.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.

Experience partnering closely with FP&A or Corporate Finance teams.

Background in strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, or venture capital.
Experience with Snowflake and Looker.

Why you’ll love it at Preply

Help shape Preply’s next stage of growth, supporting strategic planning, fundraising, and our journey toward IPO.

Benefits

We are a high-performance team embedded in a top-performing quantitative equity fund that manages over $78+ billion USD in financial assets. Based on the west coast in Vancouver, we value mentorship, collaboration, and growth in a supportive and innovative environment. Join us to make a significant impact on our investment outcomes and overall success.

What You Will Do

This is an exciting full-time role for individuals who are enthusiastic about learning the quantitative equity investment management business and excited to tackle a broad range of data, investment, and technology challenges.

You will start with a comprehensive training program, learning about various elements of quantitative equity investment management and our investment process.

You will then continue to a specialized role utilizing data analytics and data science skillsets to enable the Quantitative Equity Team’s research. Your role will involve identifying and assessing brand new data, data exploration, and proposing robust ways to integrate data products from many sources.

You will be supported with coaching and mentorship from senior members of the team, and we will create the conditions for you to grow your career steadily over time. This is an opportunity for ambitious individuals

to drive their career growth in data.

Role

Create processes to assess, explore, and link billions of data points.

Assess new data opportunities for quality and usefulness.
Evaluate your data solutions for sensibility, accuracy, and bias.
Collaborate with quantitative researchers – support alpha projects with your data expertise.
Collaborate with technology specialists – help trade off application performance and operational feasibility.
Support production deployments of your work to ensure long-term reliability.
Enable clarity of and access to your work through robust documentation and exposition.
Present findings and recommendations to key stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.

What You Bring

Academic Training – At a minimum, an undergraduate degree in finance, mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline. Completion of a relevant graduate degree is considered an asset.

We welcome applications from candidates with different levels of experience, including interns, new graduates, and experienced professionals. jobs.title: Statistical Data Analyst
jobs.description:
The role can be based in Alice Holt, Farnham, Surrey GU10 4LH or in Northern Research Station, Roslin, Midlothian EH25 9SY with blended working which gives you the option to work some of the week from home, and some of the week from the workplace. You will be asked to express a location preference during the application process.

Please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas.

Job Summary

Part of the Forestry Commission family, Forest Research is a world leader in applied forest science, providing evidence and practical solutions to policy makers, forestry practitioners, land managers and anyone with green space, UK-wide. With climate and biodiversity in crisis, and an increasing number of pests and diseases, our research is more vital than ever before. We advise on how woodlands can help combat climate change. We’re identifying tree species that will thrive in the future and ways of safeguarding those species at risk. Our research supports UK timber production because fewer imports reduce carbon emissions. We provide data on forests in Scotland, Wales and England, and provide evidence of the societal benefits of woodland. We do all this working collaboratively with academia, partners and industry, nationally and internationally.

The Forest Information and Statistics team is a multi-disciplinary team including statisticians, spatial analysts, data scientists and others.  There are 3 teams within Forest Information and Statistics, covering National Forest Inventory scheduling and mapping, National Forest Inventory analysis and outputs, and Statistics. Together, they are responsible for overseeing data collection and providing analysis and support to a range of internal and external customers and for producing a range of analytical outputs, including official statistics and the National Forest Inventory. 

Job Description

The purpose of the job is to contribute to policy development, monitoring and evaluation of sustainable forest management by supporting analysis and provision of advice on economic aspects of forestry. The postholder will also support Forest Research’s Official Statistics team in ensuring compliance with the Code of Practice for Statistics.

Key Work Areas:

Working with the project lead on the development of statistics on timber utilisation to support the timber in construction roadmap, by consulting on requirements, identifying data sources and developing a methodology to produce statistics on the use of wood fibre.
Using R and/or SAS to process data and test methodology for statistics produced as part of the Official Statistics outputs and timber utilisation.
Supporting the economic lead with the collection and management of data on economic aspects of forestry (annual surveys of the UK timber industry and other data sources) by carrying out data cleaning and compiling reports using their outputs.
Working with other members of the team to carry out quality assurance of Official Statistics and the methods used to produce them to ensure compliance with the Code of Practice for Statistics.
Attending cross-departmental groups with the economic lead, such as the Expert Group on Timber & Trade Statistics, to stay up to date on discussions that have an impact on the statistics produced in the team.

Person specification

The below criteria are desirable only. These will not be assessed throughout the recruitment process, but will be used in the event of tied scores between candidates.

Behaviours

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:

Delivering at Pace
Communicating and Influencing

Alongside your salary of £33,854, Forestry Commission - Forest Research contributes £9,807 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

Your career

Excellent professional development opportunities which are tailored to your role, with paid professional membership subscriptions, mentoring, and Civil Service Learning available to all

access to world class laboratory facilities, as well as state of the art buildings within forest or science park settings

Your work/life balance

flexible working options such as: up to two days flexi leave per month, blended working, part-time working, paid special leave, career breaks, and unpaid leave. Parents and carers will be supported to enable you to manage work and family responsibilities

A generous annual leave allowance of 25 days on entry increasing by 1 day each year to a maximum of 30 days (pro-rata for part-timers). Plus 2.5 days of additional leave and 8 days’ paid bank/public holidays

Your wellbeing

With maternity, adoption, and/or shared parental leave there’s the flexibility to have up to 26 weeks full pay, followed by 13 weeks statutory pay and a further 13 weeks unpaid leave. Paternity leave of up to two weeks is available with full pay.

Any move to Forest Research from another employer will mean you can no longer access childcare vouchers. This includes moves between government departments. You may however be eligible for other government schemes, including Tax-Free Childcare. Determine your eligibility at https://www.childcarechoices.gov.uk/.

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

This vacancy is using Success Profiles (opens in a new window), and will assess your Behaviours and Experience.

Please apply at Civil Service Jobs - GOV.UK

You Will Be Asked To:

Complete a CV setting out your career history, highlighting specific responsibilities and achievements that are relevant for this role. Please ensure you have provided reasons for any gaps within the last two years
Submit a Personal Statement – limited to 500 words
Provide a 250 word statement for each of the three listed Behaviours: Delivering at Pace, Communicating & Influencing and Working Together We will use this information to assess your application against the essential criteria in the person specification.

Shortlist

The panel will select a shortlist of candidates whose applications best demonstrate suitability for the role, by considering the evidence provided against the Essential Criteria set out in the Person Specification. Failure to address any or all of these may affect your application.

Sift is planned to take place week commencing 5th October 2026

Interviews are in person at Alice Holt, Farnham and Northern Research Station, Roslin in week commencing 19 October 2026

If we receive a large volume of applications, then we will sift on CV (Experience) and the lead behaviour Delivering at Pace.

Applicants invited to attend for interview will be required to prepare a presentation. The topic is : 'Describe a piece of work you have undertaken to carry out statistical analysis including the methodology you chose, how you handled the data, explaining your analysis to a non expert audience. Further instructions will be provided to candidates shortlisted for interview.

At interview stage you will be assessed on your experience, your presentation and the following 3 behaviours: Delivering at Pace, Working Together and Changing & Improving. The presentation will be evaluated against the essential criteria advertised.

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.

Candidates who are judged to be a near miss at interview may be considered for other positions in Forest Research which may be at a lower grade but have a potential skills match.

Diverse perspectives and experiences are critical to our success and we welcome applications from all people from all backgrounds with the experience and skills needed to perform this role.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager-1
new_jobs.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses (https://www.idexcorp.com/our-businesses/business-segments/) around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

Reports to:
Sr. Director, PMO

Function:
Project Management / Enterprise Execution / Strategic Initiatives

Location:
Remote Based in the US, Preferably in Eastern and Central time zones

Travel:
As needed to support project launches, milestone reviews, business leader working sessions, and implementation activities across the business footprint.

Role Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for leading cross-functional projects that translate strategic priorities into clear, actionable, and measurable execution plans. Reporting to the Sr. Director, PMO, this role will help drive disciplined project execution across the organization by defining project scope, milestones, deliverables, owners, risks, decision points, and success metrics.

This role is designed for a highly resourceful, business-minded project leader who can operate effectively in ambiguity, influence without authority, and move seamlessly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution. The Project Manager will partner closely with business leaders, functional leaders, site teams, and initiative owners to ensure work is prioritized, resourced, governed, and executed with focus and accountability.

The role will support execution of the organization’s critical priorities by building integrated project plans, establishing governance routines, tracking progress, escalating risks, and helping teams make practical trade-offs between competing priorities. The following role profile emphasizes converting strategic priorities into initiatives with clear outcomes, owners, milestones, and operating cadences, and this Project Manager role is intended to bring that same execution discipline to the PMO.

Key Outcomes

Role

Success in this role will be measured by the Project Manager’s ability to create clarity, momentum, and accountability across complex initiatives. Strong performance will be demonstrated when:

Projects have clear charters, objectives, milestones, owners, deliverables, risks, decision points, and measurable outcomes.
Project teams understand what is in scope, what is out of scope, what work must stop or shift, and who owns each key action.
Initiative governance is operating with disciplined cadences, clear escalation paths, and timely decision-making.
Project risks, dependencies, and resource constraints are surfaced early and actively managed.
Stakeholders receive clear, concise, and executive-ready communication on project status, progress, risks, decisions, and next steps.
Projects are connected to business priorities and supported by practical tools, routines, and operating mechanisms that help teams execute consistently.
Teams remain focused on the “critical few” priorities and avoid fragmentation across disconnected workstreams, consistent with the emphasis in the attached document on narrowing priorities, clarifying ownership, and reinforcing execution through operating routines.

Core Responsibilities

Lead Project Planning and Execution

Translate strategic initiatives, business priorities, and functional objectives into integrated project plans with clear deliverables, timelines, milestones, owners, dependencies, and success metrics.
Develop and maintain project plans, workback schedules, risk logs, issue trackers, decision logs, stakeholder maps, and status reporting tools.
Ensure each project has a clearly defined scope, business case, expected outcomes, resource requirements, and governance model.
Drive execution discipline by ensuring project teams understand priorities, timing, decision rights, and accountabilities.
Proactively identify barriers to progress and work with leaders and team members to resolve issues quickly.
Maintain momentum across multiple workstreams while ensuring project teams remain focused on the highest-value activities.

Establish Governance, Cadence, and Accountability

Create and manage project governance routines, including project team meetings, steering committee updates, milestone reviews, decision forums, and escalation processes.
Ensure project progress is visible through consistent reporting, clear metrics, and timely communication.
Track actions, owners, decisions, risks, and dependencies to ensure accountability across the project team.
Escalate risks and decisions appropriately, ensuring leaders have the information needed to make timely and informed decisions.
Help reinforce disciplined operating routines so that project execution is embedded into how leaders manage the business, consistent with the attached document’s emphasis on cadence, governance, decision forums, and escalation paths.

Partner Cross-Functionally to Drive Results

Partner with business leaders, functional leaders, site leaders, and initiative owners to align project work with business priorities.
Coordinate across functions such as Operations, Finance, HR, Commercial, Continuous Improvement, IT, Supply Chain, and other business teams as needed.
Build strong working relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and influence progress without relying on direct authority.
Drive clarity on roles, responsibilities, decision rights, resource needs, and expected outcomes.
Facilitate alignment when priorities compete, information is incomplete, or stakeholders have differing perspectives.
Help leaders and teams make practical trade-offs regarding scope, timing, budget, resources, and value.

Manage Risk, Issues, Dependencies, and Change

Identify project risks, issues, dependencies, resource constraints, and potential execution gaps early.
Develop mitigation plans and partner with stakeholders to remove roadblocks.
Monitor project health and provide fact-based updates on schedule, scope, budget, quality, adoption, and business impact.
Anticipate the operational, financial, organizational, and people-related implications of project decisions.
Support change management activities by helping teams understand what is changing, why it matters, what is expected, and how success will be measured.
Ensure communication is clear, timely, and tailored to the needs of different stakeholder groups.

Support Business Prioritization and Value Creation

Apply strong business and financial acumen to understand how projects support growth, margin improvement, operational performance, productivity, customer outcomes, or organizational effectiveness.
Help teams focus work on the highest-value priorities and reduce effort on lower-value activities.
Use data, metrics, and business insights to inform project decisions, status updates, and recommendations.
Support project prioritization by helping leaders understand resource needs, trade-offs, timing implications, and execution risks.
Where applicable, help connect project work to 80/20 thinking, customer/product priorities, operational routines, and value-creation opportunities, reflecting the attached document’s focus on using 80/20 principles to support simplification, segmentation, profitable growth, and resource allocation.

Communicate with Executive Presence

Prepare clear, concise, and executive-ready project updates, including status summaries, dashboards, decision documents, risk updates, and milestone reports.
Communicate complex project information in a way that is simple, structured, and actionable.
Tailor communication to different audiences, including senior leaders, project sponsors, functional partners, and implementation teams.
Facilitate meetings effectively, ensuring discussions are focused, decisions are captured, owners are assigned, and follow-up actions are completed.
Demonstrate strong leadership presence, sound judgment, and confidence when presenting project updates, raising risks, and recommending solutions.

Build Repeatable PMO Tools and Practices

Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of PMO tools, templates, routines, and project management standards.
Create practical tools that make project execution easier, more consistent, and more transparent for business and functional teams.
Identify opportunities to improve project governance, reporting, decision-making, and execution discipline.
Capture lessons learned and share best practices across projects and teams.
Help build a culture of accountability, action orientation, and disciplined execution.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Human Resources, Organizational Effectiveness, or a related field.
Project management experience leading cross-functional initiatives in a complex, matrixed, or multi-site environment.
Demonstrated ability to build project plans, manage timelines, track milestones, identify risks, and drive accountability.
Experience working with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with the ability to understand operational, financial, organizational, and customer implications of project work.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare executive-ready updates and facilitate decision-making conversations.
Proven ability to influence without authority and drive results through collaboration.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
High comfort level operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists.
Proficiency with project management tools, Microsoft Office applications, and project reporting methods.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in manufacturing, industrial, engineering, operational, commercial, or global business environments.
Experience supporting strategic initiatives, transformation programs, operating model deployment, integration efforts, or enterprise-level business priorities.
Familiarity with business operating rhythms such as goal deployment, daily management, monthly business reviews, or similar management systems.
Experience supporting initiatives tied to 80/20, simplification, segmentation, profitable growth, operational improvement, or resource prioritization.

Working Conditions

Role may require travel to business sites, project launch meetings, milestone reviews, and leadership working sessions.
Must be able to support projects across multiple functions, businesses, and stakeholder groups.
Must be comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with evolving business needs.
Must be able to work effectively in both strategic planning discussions and detailed execution environments.

This role combines technical project leadership with hands-on software development expertise to guide projects from planning through delivery.

You’ll work at the intersection of business requirements and engineering execution, translating needs into clear technical plans and actionable tasks.

The position requires enough technical depth to understand code, architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, and development workflows.

You’ll coordinate developers, designers, QA specialists, and other technical contributors while keeping projects aligned with scope, timelines, and quality standards.

The role also involves identifying risks, resolving blockers, facilitating Agile ceremonies, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.

You’ll contribute directly to technical discussions and decisions rather than operating solely as an administrative project manager.

This is a fully remote opportunity suited to an organized, analytical professional who can combine technical judgment with strong project leadership.

Accountabilities

Lead technical projects through the full lifecycle, from requirements gathering and planning through development, testing, deployment, and post-launch support.
Translate business requirements into clear technical requirements, user stories, specifications, and development tasks.
Create project plans, establish timelines, assign responsibilities, and manage priorities across multiple concurrent projects.
Coordinate developers, designers, QA specialists, and other technical contributors to keep delivery on track.
Review technical solutions and provide informed input on architecture, integrations, database structures, APIs, and development approaches.

Identify and implement improvements to project management and software development processes.

Strong hands-on programming experience with one or more languages or frameworks such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Java, C#, React, Node.js, or similar technologies.

new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Operations
new_jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options | Benefits

Help build the future of customer operations

We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.

We’re looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager
to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.

This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.

What You’ll Do

Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo

You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.

Build strong partnerships at every level

You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.

Drive change, not just delivery

You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets
Manage cross-collective programmes:
Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition
Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery
Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery

Drive effective decision making to remove blockers
Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area

You Should Apply If

You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch
You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences
You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further
You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with
You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail
You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution
You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”
You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.
You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery

You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

What Makes This Role Different

Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.

You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.

You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.

How We Work 💻

Locations & Flexible Working :

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The Interview Process

Recruiter Call (30 mins) You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.
Initial Call (45 mins) You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.
Loop Stage (3 hours) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email tech-hiring@monzo.com

What’s In It For You

💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

new_jobs.description:
Technical Program Manager

3Pillar Global builds breakthrough software products that power digital businesses. We partner with the world's leading organizations to design, build, and scale software solutions — combining human expertise with AI-driven delivery to achieve outcomes that matter.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will be the operational backbone of our most strategic client engagements. Reporting to a Product Delivery Director you will translate executive-level vision into structured, accountable program execution — owning the full delivery lifecycle from pre-SOW solutioning through to successful client outcomes.

This is not a coordination role. You will be a technical leader, a trusted delivery lead, and a practitioner who understands how modern AI-driven delivery teams operate and where human judgment is irreplaceable.

Key Responsibilities

Lead engagements where AI agents are embedded across the SDLC — from requirements gathering and code generation to testing, documentation, and release management.
Understand where AI drives genuine efficiency gains and where human-in-the-loop oversight is required to maintain quality, compliance, and client trust.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of 3Pillar's AI-driven delivery practices, bringing lessons learned from the field back into our operating model.

Note: 3Pillar operates proprietary delivery frameworks — including our Helix AI human-agent delivery model and our Lightwave Client Engagement SDLC. Candidates will not be expected to know these on day one, but should bring the foundational disciplines and AI-driven delivery experience that enable rapid adoption.

Pre-SOW Solutioning & Scoping

Partner with the Solutioning team to define engagement scope, approach, and solution architecture prior to contract execution.
Contribute to SOW development — translating client requirements into structured delivery commitments with clear assumptions, risks, and effort estimates.
Bring a point of view on how AI-driven delivery can accelerate outcomes and where it introduces risk that must be managed.

Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary day-to-day delivery lead for technical and mid-management stakeholders, building trust through consistent delivery and clear communication.
Facilitate executive-level program governance in support of the Product Delivery Director, ensuring alignment on objectives, risks, and progress.
Proactively surface issues, manage escalations, and maintain client confidence through transparency — especially on fixed-outcome engagements where contractual accountability is high.

Delivery Excellence & Program Execution

Serve as the first line of accountability for delivery success — owning outcome, schedule, quality, and engagement margin, and escalating early when any of the four is at risk.
Own end-to-end program execution across 2–3 concurrent client accounts with typical annual contract values in the $1–2M range, or a single large strategic engagement, depending on scope.
Own the quality bar for everything the engagement ships — accountable for defining what "done" means, enforcing it, and standing behind the result with the client.
Anticipate delivery bottlenecks, manage cross-functional dependencies, and drive issue resolution without waiting to be asked.
Build and maintain delivery mechanisms — cadences, dashboards, escalation paths, and reporting structures — that provide clarity to all stakeholders.
Establish and maintain the human oversight model for AI-generated work: review depth, test coverage expectations, security and compliance checks, and clear sign-off ownership at each stage of the SDLC.

new_jobs.title: Forward Deployed Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Flume Health

Flume Health is a software company that connects the fragmented healthcare data ecosystem for more efficient health plan administration. As a single, cloud-native integration platform, Flume’s Relay platform allows companies to easily connect various systems and vendors for efficient data exchange that’s increasingly demanded of the modern health plan. Payers, third-party administrators, prescription benefits managers, and health solutions are provided the simplicity, speed, and security they need to automate data integration and movement between relevant stakeholders. Relay supports multiple data transmission protocols, data types, and file types. By streamlining data flows between payers and solutions, a world of opportunity exists to improve access to healthcare.

Flume Health is hiring a Forward Deployed Program Manager to own program and integration delivery and solve complex client problems across our portfolio, with a primary focus on our largest accounts. You are the person who sits at the intersection of client needs, data integration complexity, and AI-powered execution. You figure out how to get things done, unblock delivery, and drive outcomes.

What makes this role different: you will build, manage, and continuously tune a team of AI agents that solve complete problems end-to-end. Diagnosing why a connection is failing, generating client-ready deliverables, automating workflows that used to take days. You are responsible for agent performance: refining prompts, improving outputs, expanding what your agents can handle, and pushing the boundary of what one person with AI leverage can deliver.

This role requires a consulting mindset: the ability to walk into ambiguity, structure the problem, mobilize resources (human and AI), and deliver. You will manage the program and integration delivery cadence, but more importantly, you will be the person clients call when something is hard and needs to get figured out.

This is not a traditional project management role. This is an execution-oriented position with a clear progression path into Flume's Forward Deployment and Strategic Deployment practice, where you will own client engagements that drive platform transformation and measurable business outcomes for health payers and TPAs.

What You'll Do

Client Problem-Solving:** Be the person who figures it out. When a TPA integration is failing, when a client has a data question no one can answer, when a new connection request requires scoping and creative problem-solving. You own it. Structure the problem, mobilize resources, and deliver.
AI Agent Management & Tuning:** Build, manage, and continuously improve a team of AI agents. You own agent performance. That means refining prompts, evaluating outputs, expanding agent capabilities, and tuning workflows to solve increasingly complex problems across integration diagnostics, client deliverables, reporting automation, intake processing, and data analysis.
Program & Integration Delivery Ownership:** Own the delivery cadence for our flagship account (80+ contracted connections) and a portfolio of secondary accounts. Manage the Jira intake workflow, ensure requirements are captured cleanly, and drive work through the build pipeline
Client-Facing Escalation:** Serve as the primary operational POC for key client IT and Business Operations stakeholders. Attend leadership calls, surface blockers early, and ensure delivery commitments are met.
Stakeholder Communication:** Own weekly delivery reporting to senior client stakeholders. Use AI to generate it, not your weekends
Cross-Account Coverage:** Provide problem-solving support across the broader client portfolio as needed, including delivery troubleshooting, integration scoping, and contract coordination.

What You'll Need

5+ years in consulting, implementation, or healthcare operations:** You've been the person in the room who has to figure out a hard problem with incomplete information and deliver under pressure. Strategy consulting, management consulting, implementation, or similar client-facing delivery experience.
AI-native (required):** This is non-negotiable. You build agents, tune them, measure their output quality, and expand their scope over time. You don't just use AI to summarize emails. You think in terms of what a team of well-tuned agents can do, not what you can do alone.
Client-facing confidence:** You can sit in a daily technology leadership call with senior client stakeholders and field hard questions without flinching. You're comfortable being the single point of contact when things get complicated.
Structured thinker:** You walk into ambiguity and create clarity. You break down complex integration problems into workable pieces and drive them to resolution.
Low ego, high throughput:** You're willing to do the operational work well because you understand it's the foundation for everything strategic. No task is beneath you if it moves the client forward.
Healthcare exposure preferred, not required:** If you've worked with payers, providers, claims data, or health plan operations, great. If not, you're sharp enough to ramp fast.

Nice to Haves

Experience building, tuning, and measuring AI agent workflows to solve multi-step business problems
Background in strategy consulting, management consulting, or implementation delivery at a professional services firm
Familiarity with TPA operations, claims processing, healthcare EDI, or health plan administration
Experience with Jira, Snowflake, or healthcare data integration platforms
Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage environment where scope evolves quickly

Salary

$130k - $160k + equity

Flume’s Perks & Benefits

Flexible PTO - you’re going to be working hard so enjoy time off
A robust stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in Flume’s success
WFH stipend - we’ve always been remote first
Competitive compensation and 401k with a 4% match
Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision)

Job Description

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements.
