Company Description

THE WORLD OF UBISOFT

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile
 brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

Job Description

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist
to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.

Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.

Your daily adventure:

Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.
Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.
Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.
Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.
Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.
Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.
Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.
Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.
Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends.
Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.

Qualifications

YOUR SKILLS

Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.
5+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.
Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.
Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).
Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.
Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.
Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.
Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.
Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.

Nice to Have:

Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.
Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).
Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).
Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.
Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.
Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.

Additional Information

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)

Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery).
Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday.
5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
Life Insurance with AXA.
Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
Language training in English, Spanish, and French.
Professional development training & programs, based upon request.
Ubisoft games are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).

Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

in our Information Technology department as a Senior Cyber Security Analyst. This role requires expertise in enterprise security operations, threat analysis, and governance of modern technology ecosystems, including AI-enabled solutions, ensuring the protection of sensitive data and the resilience of business operations.

The Cyber Analyst will be responsible for monitoring and analyzing security events across Qualus’ layered security architecture, including endpoint, network, email, data protection, and AI-enabled systems and services.

Additionally, the Cyber Analyst will support the secure adoption and governance of Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions across Qualus, ensuring appropriate controls, data protections, and compliance requirements are enforced.

A security first mindset, strong analytical skills, and the ability to assess risk across both traditional IT systems and AI driven technologies are critical to success in this role.

This position may require after hours support as determined by the needs of the business, including participation in incident response activities.

Responsibilities

Monitor, triage, and investigate alerts across endpoint, identity, email, network, cloud, SIEM/EDR, AI-enabled systems, and data protection platforms.
Correlate security events across Qualus enterprise security stack, including CrowdStrike Falcon Complete, Microsoft Defender, Abnormal Security, Zscaler Z4U, Meraki, Microsoft Purview, Tenable Nessus, and Falcon Next-Gen SIEM/logging platforms.

Assist with audit evidence collection, customer security questionnaires, control validation, and compliance documentation aligned with SOC 2, NIST 800-171, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and other applicable requirements.

Experience investigating security alerts, documenting findings, and supporting incident response activities.

new_jobs.description:
Research Analyst

Location:
Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
Salary range:
TZS 7,311,684–9,704,383 gross per month
Application link:
https://form.jotformeu.com/262592084102553

SUMMARY

Laterite is looking for a new Research Analyst with an understanding of data analysis and a strong motivation to work in social and economic research to join our office in Dar es Salaam. This role combines research design, data analysis, project management support, and fieldwork coordination in a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

This position is open exclusively to Tanzanian nationals.

WHO WE ARE

Laterite is a data, research, and analytics firm working on complex development challenges. We partner with universities, global think tanks, international NGOs, multilateral donors, and government ministries. Our clients include the World Bank, TechnoServe, the Mastercard Foundation, and others.

We operate across the Netherlands, Rwanda, Ethiopia, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Sierra Leone, and Peru, with 90+ full-time staff and more than 2,000 enumerators. We believe meaningful impact requires being on the ground, building local teams, and establishing long-term trust. Our office culture is collaborative and gives people autonomy to grow into their roles.

THE ENVIRONMENT YOU’RE STEPPING INTO

You will join our Tanzania team in a high-trust environment. We are low on bureaucracy but high on individual accountability. You won’t be micromanaged here—we want you to use your judgment to solve problems, support our fast-paced field teams, and actively improve the systems you work with.
Laterite was founded in 2010 in Kigali, and our office in Dar es Salaam opened in 2021. Our project portfolio in Tanzania is varied and ranges from data collection (including mixed-methods studies) to full-cycle research projects. The Tanzania team works across all our key sectors with the majority of projects in education, public health and agriculture topics. Our team in Tanzania currently consists of 5 team members.

While based in our Dar es Salaam office, you will support Laterite’s Uganda team, contributing to projects in both countries. The Uganda portfolio is just as varied, combining data collection with full-cycle research studies, and spans the agriculture, public health, education and energy sectors. You will collaborate with the Uganda team remotely.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

1 Supporting research projects

Support the ethical approval process, research design, and development of research instruments.
Conduct quantitative and qualitative data analysis.
Draft sections of reports and presentations for clients.
Support communication with clients and internal project teams on project progress.

2 Contributing to data collection

Code survey instruments using SurveyCTO and other ODK-based platforms.
Collaborate with field teams to develop training materials and support enumerator trainings.
Participate in field visits to understand and improve data collection processes.

3 Strengthening data quality and analysis

Monitor, clean, and validate incoming survey data.
Work closely with field teams to resolve data quality issues.
Support statistical analysis and interpretation of findings.
Contribute to consultancy-quality reports and data-driven insights.

4 Contributing to business development (Optional)

If you are interested, there is also room to contribute to our business development efforts, either through proactive business development or by contributing to the development of technical and financial proposals.

WHAT YOU BRING

We are looking for a colleague with strong quantitative data analysis skills and a motivation to work on socio-economic development research. Specifically, you have:
A completed Master’s degree in Economics, Public Health, Development or related fields.
At least one year of professional experience in similar roles or tasks. (We welcome experience gained through internships, dissertation work, or participation in an academic research group, provided you can demonstrate how this experience meets the requirements of the role.)
Strong quantitative data analysis skills and proficiency in Stata.
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English and Kiswahili.

In addition, we welcome:
Experience working with ODK-based platforms (e.g., SurveyCTO).
Previous work experience in Tanzania.
Organizational and interpersonal skills, self-motivation and drive to work in a collaborative environment.

WHAT YOU’LL LEARN AND DEVELOP

Technical research design, including sampling and impact evaluation methodologies.
Project management and client communication.
Advanced data analysis, statistical techniques, and coding skills.
Report writing and presentation of findings in a consultancy-quality format.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation. TZS 7,311,684 - TZS 9,704,383
gross monthly salary (exact grade determined by experience/interviews), medical insurance, pension contribution, and 21 days of annual leave.
Professional growth.
We are also committed to supporting our staff’s learning, providing an annual learning budget of up to USD 1,000 per person and 10 days of time off for professional learning each year.
Flexibility.
We also provide remote work options in accordance with Laterite’s remote work policy.

READY TO BUILD WITH US? NEXT STEPS

Online assessment.
Complete a 30-minute online verbal reasoning and quantitative assessment. No special preparation is required. Link: https://form.jotformeu.com/262592084102553

Application.
Candidates who successfully complete the online assessment will be invited to submit a brief screening questionnaire, along with their CV, through our online application system.
Analytical assessment.
Selected candidates will complete a technical exercise involving statistical analysis using Stata, R, or Python.
Interviews.
Candidates who successfully complete the analytical assessment will be invited to a first interview. The interview stage consists of up to three interviews.

DEADLINE

Applications will be considered on a rolling basis. Details on rolling applications can be found on the website: laterite.com/vacancies.

For questions about the role or application process, please contact jobs@laterite.com

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

The role

Nebius is looking for a highly capable India Supply Chain Security Manager to own and lead all supply chain security operations across India. This role carries full dual-domain responsibility, covering both warehouse and transportation security, making it one of the most comprehensive country-level security mandates within the NGSCS structure.

Reporting to the APAC Supply Chain Security Manager, this individual will serve as the primary NGSCS authority for all supply chain security matters in India, establishing vendor relationships, enforcing security standards across warehouse and transportation partners, responding to security incidents, and maintaining full alignment with global NGSCS policies and procedures.

Warehouse Security

Own and lead warehouse security across all facilities in India, with full accountability for facility-level risk and performance
Ensure the secure storage, handling, and integrity of high-value assets across all warehouse and staging facilities in the country
Establish and enforce security requirements acrosslogistics partners operating warehouse and storage facilities, including 3PLs and co-located vendors

Drive continuous improvement of security capabilities across the India vendor andlogistics partner network

Full country ownership of both warehouse and transportation supply chain security across India, spanning a geographically large and operationally diverse market
Regular engagement with 3PLs, carriers, facility managers, freight forwarders, and security vendorsoperating across India
Travel within Indiarequired for facility site visits, route assessments, partner reviews, and incident response
Operates as part of the broader NGSCS APAC structure, with close coordination with the APAC Supply Chain Security Manager

Minimum 7 years experience in supply chain security, logistics security, or a combined warehouse and transportation security role

Strong experience working with both warehouse and facility security and in-transit transportation security operations
Demonstrated experience working with Indianlogistics providers, 3PLs, carriers, and security vendors
Demonstrated experience leading incident response across warehouse and transportation security events
Familiarity with India's regulatory and compliance environment as it relates tologistics, security, and asset protection
Ability tooperate independently with a high degree of ownership and accountability
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across internal and external partners
Analytical and structured approach to risk assessment and problem-solving
Fluent English (spoken and written); Hindi language proficiency preferred

Experience in high-value or critical infrastructure supply chain security (e.g., data centers, AI hardware, electronics, technology hardware)
Background in Indian law enforcement, military (security-related roles), or corporate security
Familiarity with TAPA FSR, TAPA TSR, or equivalent supply chain security standards
Familiarity with supply chain security technologies (e.g., GPS tracking, geofencing, access control systems, CCTV, tamper-evident sealing)
Experience working within a global or regional organization with cross-border coordination requirements
Understanding of thelogistics and security landscape across key Indian cities and corridors, including major distribution hubs and inter-city freight routes

Operates within a global NGSCS environment requiring coordination across multiple time zones, including NGSCS teams in APAC, the EU, USA, Israel, and Taiwan

will execute all tasks and activities needed to support requirements management for NATO capabilities
The Capability Requirements (CR)
Branch will develop the Capability Requirements Brief and recommended courses of action to resolve issues through the life cycle management of requirements using matrixed, cross-functional project-specific Requirements Management teams.
The Requirements Forward Branch (Mons)
is responsible for conducting requirements development and management representation and engagement-related functions in Europe.
The Capability Division
coordinates the development of capabilities from capability planning through acceptance and then disposal with management entities, NATO Headquarters staff and the NATO Governance Structure
The Capability Forward Branch (Mons)
coordinates with ACO, NCIA, NSPA, NATO HQ, territorial Host Nations, and NATO Centres of Excellence (COEs) to support the development of capabilities.
Strategic Plans and Policy (SPP)
supports Allied Command Transformation in formalizing military advice to shape future military strategy, political guidance, and other policy documents supporting NATO’s strategic objectives.
Role ID: ACT-CDMS-27-01-A-LC11

Role Background

The Operational Analysis Branch provides analysts to capability development programme teams to drive and support evidence-based decision making in requirements derivation and programmatic planning. In this SOW, “Operational Analysis” (predominantly military term) is used interchangeably with “Operations Research” (US term) and “Operational Research” (UK Term).
Course of Action (COA) analysis supports capability development programme teams to determine appropriate DOTMLPFI methods and capability architectures for meeting the military user’s operational requirements and defining programmatic structures.
Analysis of Alternatives (AoA) involves the comparative assessment of options in terms of costs, risks, schedules and operational effectiveness. The AoA tests the commercial marketplace and NATO’s ability to re-use capabilities that are in service in member Nations militaries. It establishes whether NATO should procure a managed service, adopt National capability solutions, acquire products from industry, or must develop bespoke solutions. For complex programmes, the AoA can inform programmatic structures by showing how value for money is most likely to be achieved.
NATO capability development decisions concern complex socio-technical systems, including computer information systems supporting NATO command and control, federated governance arrangements, capability integration activities and multinational delivery models. Analysts must be capable of combining quantitative and qualitative evidence and facilitating stakeholder engagement to support defensible decision-making. COA analysis and AoA typically involves engaging with the programme team to understand programmatic areas of uncertainty, designing and facilitating workshops to gather stakeholder views (including within the military NATO Command Structure, delivery Agencies and Centres of Excellence and / or the NATO Force Structure, gathering or generating (if appropriate) cost, risk schedule and effectiveness evidence, and comparative options assessment. This may include the development or elicitation of Measures of Performance (MoPs) and Measures of Effectiveness (MoEs); assessment of absolute and comparative risks; elicitation of schedule estimates; and review of cost estimates for appropriateness to support this assessment.
Operations Research methods can be applied at any stage of the capability development programme, including, but not limited to: decision science (e.g. multi-criteria decision analysis), optimization (e.g. linear programming), modelling & simulation, behavioural operations research, data science (e.g. advanced analytics and machine learning) and wargaming.
Roles Duties and Responsibilities

Contribute to Course of Action analysis using Operations Research and Analysis methods in support of Capability Development within ACT in order to mature NATO capability requirements and set programmatic direction.
Plan and conduct research to study and establish qualitative and quantitative assessments of operational effectiveness, undertake cost-effectiveness and risk-benefit studies and analyses.
Where necessary and appropriate, interact with NATO and National research entities and industries to establish the impact of alternatives on operational effectiveness.
Where necessary and appropriate, attend engagements or workshops with NATO, National organizations, and / or industry to ensure cost estimation activities are likely to provide outputs of appropriate quality to support analysis.
Support the creation of Requests for Information and surveys to NATO Nations, Non Governmental Organizations, and industry.
Analyse the potential impact of identified individual and aggregated risks, and propose possible risk management approaches.
Elicit, and / or review and assess schedule estimates, to ensure appropriate quality and supporting evidence for decisions being supported by analysis.
Review and assess cost estimates provided by others, to ensure appropriate quality and supporting evidence for decisions being supported by analysis.
Analyse and document comparative assessments of cost, risk, schedule and operational effectiveness to inform programmatic decision-making.
Produce decision briefs / presentations describing the underlying rationale / justification for analytical outcomes. If appropriate, brief decision-makers on the context, process and outcomes.
Produce written reports of analysis conducted as part of the Capability Programme plan evidence package, for review with the International Military Staff and International Staff in NATO Headquarters.
Produce summary briefs of lessons identified / lessons learned to support continuous improvement of NATO capability development and OA branch skills and competencies.
May be required to travel to meetings and conferences both within and outside NATO boundaries for up to 60 days per year.
Perform additional tasks as required by the COTR related to the LABOR category.

Essential Skills & Qualifications

Minimum two examples in the last 10 years (at least 3 years combined duration) in the field of military Operations Research / Operational Analysis / Data Science, supporting policy development, capability development or acquisition. With a relevant Bachelor’s degree (listed above), only 2 years in the last 5 must be in the fields / areas /listed above.
Experience designing, leading, and facilitating structured stakeholder engagements to elicit objectives, assumptions, measures, risks, preferences and expert judgement in support of defence capability decisions involving technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple levels of seniority.
Experience, within last 5 years of determining Operations Research / Operational Analysis requirements, scoping problems for study, developing analysis plans, and delivering high quality outputs that influence senior decision makers.
Experience of developing data collection and analysis plans or assessment frameworks that include measures of effectiveness and measures of performance.
Experience in gathering evidence and scoring effectiveness through use of operations research and analysis methods to defence domain issues.
Experience identifying, eliciting, assessing, analysing and communicating uncertainty and risk associated with capability / acquisition, project, programme, or portfolio decisions.
Experience of producing or working with cost and schedule estimates, including estimating methodologies, methods and processes
Experience working in a strategic or operational military command or multinational organization.
Experience supporting project, programme, and / or portfolio decisions through analytical assessment in the past 10 years, within complex and dynamic programme environments.

Desirable Qualifications

Experience using AI to support OA.

Education or Relevant Professional Experience

A Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering or equivalent quantitative degree. Alternatively, 5+ years of Operations Research/ Operational Analysis experience conducting and leading analytical studies in relevant military, strategic, political or international environment.

Language Proficiency

Business English

The Principal Program Manager, Environmental Compliance provides enterprise-level environmental compliance oversight, technical direction, and program governance for Great Lakes Cheese Manufacturing and Packaging facilities. This role is responsible for maintaining a consistent, risk-based environmental compliance program across the organization, and ensures that EHS, Plant and Executive leadership are informed of all environmental compliance concerns, leading indicators, potential issues, and actual compliance events.

Provide corporate-level technical guidance and expertise for environmental compliance, permitting, environmental engineering controls, and environmental risk management across all cheese manufacturing and cheese packaging facilities.
Provide multi-site environmental compliance oversight for all cheese manufacturing and cheese packaging facilities in the network.
Provide site leadership guidance for the day-to-day environmental execution responsibility of local plants, including providing corporate governance, technical support, escalation, and assurance.
Lead and maintain oversight of environmental compliance programs across the organization, including wastewater, air emissions, stormwater, spill prevention, waste management, chemical reporting, permitting, recordkeeping, and regulatory submissions.
Maintain and guide the corporate environmental compliance governance model, ensuring clarity of roles and responsibilities across EHS, plant leadership, engineering, maintenance, operations, and external consultants.
Lead and support the development of corporate responses, technical guidance, implementation plans, and standardized interpretations to drive consistent action by plants.
Review and provide direction on environmental aspects of facility design, process changes, capital projects, equipment upgrades, wastewater treatment systems, air emission controls, utilities, refrigeration-related programs, and other operational changes to support compliance by design.

6 years of progressive environmental compliance or environmental management experience in manufacturing.

Strong leadership, organization, project management, prioritization, and influencing skills in a matrixed, multi-site environment.
Ability to communicate effectively with plant personnel, operators, maintenance, engineering, site leadership, corporate leaders, regulators, consultants, and legal counsel.
Demonstrated understanding of environmental permitting, reporting, recordkeeping, compliance calendars, agency submissions, environmental metrics, and audit/corrective action processes.
Proficient in Microsoft Office and environmental data management or compliance tracking systems; ability to use data visualization and reporting tools preferred.
Ability to travel up to 40% to support plant visits, audits, agency inspections, project reviews, and compliance assurance across the nine-plant network.
Must be legally authorized to work for a company in the U.S. without sponsorship.
Working knowledge of federal environmental regulations and the ability to interpret state and local requirements applicable to manufacturing facilities.
Experience building practical compliance systems that can be executed consistently by plant teams.
Ability to balance compliance assurance, operational practicality, risk escalation, and continuous improvement across multiple facilities.

Preferred Education And Experience

Wastewater treatment certifications or operator licensure; professional certification such as CHMM, REM, PE, or equivalent credential preferred.
8-12 years of progressive environmental compliance or environmental management experience in manufacturing.
Experience supporting multiple facilities.
Experience with EPA RMP, OSHA PSM interface, ammonia refrigeration environmental considerations, SPCC, stormwater, air permitting, EPCRA/Tier II/Form R, hazardous and non-hazardous waste, and wastewater pretreatment requirements.

About Nebius

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is looking for a APAC Supply Chain Security Manager to own and lead supply chain security across the Asia-Pacific region. This is one of the most significant and wide-ranging roles within the NGSCS structure, a rare opportunity to build a regional security function from scratch in one of the world's most strategically important and operationally complex logistics markets.

APAC represents a developing and rapidly expanding operational theatre for Nebius. The person in this role will be the sole NGSCS presence in the region, carrying full accountability for all supply chain security operations across APAC, spanning both warehouse and transportation security, across a geographically vast, multi-jurisdictional, and commercially diverse environment. From high-growth logistics hubs like Singapore to emerging markets across Southeast Asia and beyond, this role demands a security professional who can operate with full ownership, sound judgment, and entrepreneurial drive.

Based in Singapore, the natural gateway to APAC logistics operations, this individual will establish the regional security framework, build the vendor and partner ecosystem, define the risk profile across key markets, and deliver operational security outcomes from day one. They will serve as the NGSCS authority for all things APAC, working in close alignment with global leadership while operating with the independence required to get things done in a complex and fast-moving regional environment.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Regional Function Establishment

Build the NGSCS APAC security function from the ground up, establishing the operational framework, regional risk profile, and partner ecosystem required to secure Nebius supply chain operations across the region
Define and implement regional adaptations of global NGSCS security standards, ensuring they are operationally effective across diverse APAC markets and jurisdictions
Identify, assess, and onboard regional security vendors, guarding providers, logistics partners, and technology platforms in alignment with NGSCS requirements
Map and assess the APAC supply chain security landscape, identifying key threat vectors, market-specific risks, and operational vulnerabilities across the region
Establish NGSCS's presence and authority across the APAC vendor and logistics partner network, setting clear expectations for security performance from the outset

Warehouse Security

Own and lead warehouse security across all APAC facilities, with full accountability for facility-level risk and performance
Ensure the secure storage, handling, and integrity of high-value assets across all warehouse and staging facilities in the region
Establish and enforce security requirements across logistics partners operating warehouse and storage facilities, including 3PLs and co-located vendors across APAC markets
Manage physical security standards across facilities, including access control, CCTV, guard force oversight, and alarm systems
Conduct and oversee facility security assessments and audits, benchmarking against TAPA FSR and NGSCS standards
Lead end-to-end response to warehouse security incidents (e.g., theft, loss, unauthorized access, inventory discrepancies), including coordination, investigation, and resolution

Transportation Security

Own and lead transportation security across all APAC shipment lanes, with full accountability for in-transit risk and performance
Ensure the secure handling, packaging, and movement of high-value assets across all transportation nodes within the APAC region
Establish and enforce security requirements across transportation partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, and last-mile delivery providers across APAC markets
Conduct risk assessments across transportation routes, handoff points, and carrier operations, and implement effective mitigation strategies
Manage GPS tracking, geofencing, and real-time monitoring of assets across active regional shipments
Lead end-to-end response to in-transit security incidents (e.g., theft, loss, diversion, tampering), including coordination, investigation, and resolution

Regional Leadership & Global Coordination

Serve as the sole NGSCS authority and escalation point for all supply chain security matters across APAC
Maintain close alignment with the Global Transportation Security Manager and NGSCS global leadership, providing regular visibility into regional performance, risks, and developments
Provide structured intelligence on emerging threats, regulatory changes, and logistics security developments across APAC markets to inform global NGSCS strategy
Monitor and report on regional security performance, risks, and incidents across both warehouse and transportation domains
Drive continuous improvement of regional security capabilities as the APAC function matures, the vendor network develops, and the Nebius operational footprint grows

Operational Scope

Full regional ownership of all supply chain security operations across APAC, warehouse and transportation as the sole NGSCS presence in the region. Note: Taiwan operations are managed separately under a dedicated NGSCS Taiwan role and fall outside the scope of this position
Initial scope covers the current APAC operational footprint, with accountability expanding in line with Nebius's growth across the region
Engagement across a wide range of APAC markets, logistics environments, and regulatory jurisdictions
Significant regional travel required across APAC markets for facility assessments, vendor engagement, route reviews, and incident response
Based in Singapore, operating as the regional hub for NGSCS APAC activity

We Expect You To Have

Significant experience in supply chain security, logistics security, or a combined warehouse and transportation security role
Proven operational experience across the APAC region, with strong understanding of local logistics, regulatory, and security environments across multiple markets
Demonstrated experience building or establishing a security function, team, or regional operational presence in a new or emerging market
Strong experience across both warehouse and facility security and in-transit transportation security operations
Demonstrated experience leading incident response across warehouse and transportation security events in complex, multi-jurisdiction environments
High degree of independence, ownership, and entrepreneurial drive — comfortable creating structure and making sound judgments in ambiguous situations
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across internal leadership and external partners spanning multiple cultures, languages, and business environments
Analytical and structured approach to risk assessment, problem-solving, and regional threat profiling
Fluent English (spoken and written); proficiency in an additional APAC language is preferred

It Will Be An Added Bonus If You Have

Experience in high-value or critical infrastructure supply chain security across APAC (e.g., AI hardware, data centers, semiconductors, electronics)
Background in law enforcement, military, or corporate security with significant APAC regional exposure
Familiarity with TAPA FSR, TAPA TSR, or equivalent supply chain security standards
Familiarity with supply chain security technologies (e.g., GPS tracking, geofencing, access control systems, CCTV, tamper-evident sealing, real-time monitoring platforms)
Deep understanding of logistics and regulatory environments across key APAC markets, including Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Japan and South Korea
Experience working within a global organization with cross-regional coordination requirements

Operational Expectations

This is a pioneering, high-ownership role. The successful candidate will thrive in an environment that is being defined in real time and will take pride in building something of lasting operational significance
Full dual-domain responsibility across warehouse and transportation security requires strong personal organization and the ability to manage multiple concurrent operational priorities
Security incidents across either domain may require availability and response outside standard working hours
Operates within a global NGSCS environment requiring regular coordination across multiple time zones, including teams in the EU, USA, Israel, and Taiwan
Significant regional travel across APAC is expected as a core part of the role, particularly during the establishment phase
Supported by the Global Transportation Security Manager and NGSCS global leadership, with clear and full ownership of all supply chain security outcomes across the APAC region

Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams

What's It Like To Work At Nebius

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

new_jobs.description:
DE&S Ashchurch, Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire GL20 8LZ

Job Summary

At Defence Equipment & Support (DE&S), we supply and maintain vital equipment and services for the Royal Navy, British Army and Royal Air Force. Together, we deliver a vast range of essential defence programmes, and strive for what's next. Because it helps keep our military at the top of their game and our nation safe – for today, and tomorrow.

DE&S has recently been integrated into the National Armaments Director (NAD) Group. The NAD Group brings together key Ministry of Defence (MOD) organisations to unite expertise across science, technology, procurement, infrastructure, and support to provide integrated capabilities faster and more efficiently for our armed forces and our allies. This is an exciting new opportunity to enable better ways of working and empower greater collaboration across Defence. For further information about the NAD Group, please visit: National Armaments Director Group - GOV.UK

We offer 25+ days’ holiday, flexible and hybrid working, enhanced parental leave schemes, shopping discounts, and an exceptional employer pension contribution of 28.97%, to help make work work for you.

Nationality, visas and vetting: For security reasons this role is open to sole UK nationals only.] [A ‘sole UK national’ refers to an individual who holds citizenship solely in the UK, without dual citizenship or nationality from another country. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship.

This role requires you to have lived in the UK for the last 5 years and obtain Security Check (SC) security clearance. Clearance must be obtained without any caveats that prevent you from carrying out the role you’ve been recruited for. If it isn’t obtained, or is obtained but with caveats that prevent you from carrying out the role, any conditional offer made to you will be withdrawn. Obtaining SC security clearance can be a lengthy process, and we reserve the right to withdraw any conditional offer made if the necessary security clearance isn’t obtained within 12 months.

Job Description

The role of a Physical Security Operations Manager is to ensure the correct posture of physical and tactical resources to manage sites and maintain operational preparedness for security incidents.

We are currently looking for an Establishment Security Officer (ESyO) to join the NADG Non-Explosives Sites Team (NEST) general management group at MOD Ashchurch, with the responsibility of MOD Ludgershall. Our security professionals play a vital role part in assessing, evaluating and implementing security policy and strategy within Project Teams, NADG Establishments and the wider Defence Industry community. You will have primary responsibility for the physical security and integrity of the whole site and will be required to work closely with multiple stakeholders and establishment lodger units in supporting and enabling security policy and procedures. Your main duties will include regular monitoring, audits and self-inspections of all aspects of physical security, creating/maintaining mandated site security policies and assisting the wider NEST security teams.

The successful candidate will be expected to attend the MOD Establishment Security Officers Course and Business Continuity training (residential and on-line) and could eventually become a member of the Security Institute.

Candidate would be responsible for Ludgershall site.

We champion flexible ways of working. Regular in-person attendance is required (this is expected to be approximately 60% of your working week) to promote the benefits of face-to-face collaboration alongside flexibility of hours to support work-life balance and business need. new_jobs.description:
The Data Analyst
is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:

Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.

Our Ideal Candidate will possess:

2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.

What this role is not:

Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.

NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams

new_jobs.description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era.
Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen
Relay’s Mission is
to free commerce from friction
. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people
, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM

• ~110 people
, more than half
in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees
across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands
of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking
, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity

Relay’s Last Mile network runs on couriers - tens of thousands of them, doing real work in the physical world every day. Whether each parcel gets delivered successfully depends on the decisions and behaviours of the courier on route. We're hiring for a Senior Data Analyst to own how Relay measures and improves courier excellence: how we shape what happens on the doorstep, and how we manage performance before and after that interaction.
This role works with the whole of the Last Mile team and partners closely with data scientists, engineers and operators across the squad. There's a v1 of performance management already running; you'll own its evolution into something materially better.

Last Mile

Handover Optimisation:
Every handover is a trade-off between competing outcomes - speed, quality, and risk. Moving any one of them can have knock-on effects on the others, and finding the right balance is one of the most interesting analytical problems in the network. Your job is to make those trade-offs visible, model them, and find the levers that move the network in the right direction. You'll run the experiments, design the measurement, and quantify what actually works.
Performance Management:
Relay already has a framework for measuring courier performance, and it feeds into how work is distributed. The job now is to ensure it drives fleet quality - defining the right behaviours to measure, evaluating the interventions designed to help couriers shift those behaviours, and closing the loop so the framework continuously improves. You'll partner with product, ops and engineering across this work, with the analytics owned by you.
Courier-facing analytics:
Couriers are the end users of much of this work. You'll think about how performance and rewards are made transparent to them, and you'll run experiments to evaluate whether interventions are actually working for couriers and for Relay.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You're a strong analyst who thinks in systems. You break complex problems into components and know where the real opportunity lies.
You are successful working with high autonomy and are excited to operate in a Product/Programme Manager like capacity, defining the roadmap as well as executing against it.
You care about solving the problem more than which techniques you use.
You love working with smart, motivated people.
You're fluent in SQL.
You're comfortable across the analytical spectrum - designing and reading experiments, building risk scores and segmentation, and shipping descriptive analysis that drives a decision the same week.
You communicate inclusively with non-technical team members.
You love seeing the impact of your work play out in a daily operation.
Bonus: You have experience working on performance management, marketplace quality, operational analytics or another relevant domain.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.
Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.
25 days of holidays
Enhanced parental leave.
Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.
Hardware of your choice.
Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

Who Thrives at Relay?

Aim with Precision:
You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.
Play to Win:
You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.
1% Better Every Day
: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.
All In, All the Time
: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.
People-Powered Greatness
: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.
Grow the Whole Pie
: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Job description:

At Burberry, we believe creativity opens spaces. Our purpose is to unlock the power of imagination to push boundaries and open new possibilities for our people, our customers and our communities. This is the core belief that has guided Burberry since it was founded in 1856 and is central to how we operate as a company today.
We aim to provide an environment for creative minds from different backgrounds to thrive, bringing a wide range of skills and experiences to everything we do. As a purposeful, values-driven brand, we are committed to being a force for good in the world as well, creating the next generation of sustainable luxury for customers, driving industry change and championing our communities.

Job Purpose:

We are looking for a high-potential candidate to join the Decision Analytics team, a part of the wider Data & Analytics team. We are an award-winning team (DataIQ Awards 2023, 2024 & 2025) and work as an enterprise function, providing analytical support across many business areas including: commercial, customer, merchandising, marketing and platform.
You’ll make the most of a modern, well-supported data stack, utilising leading technology in the field – Databricks, Looker, and Snowplow.  You’ll find yourself in a team that delivers tangible analytical value to the business and is passionate about training and development. Finally, you’ll be working on a global scale but in a company small enough that everyone can have their voice heard and make a difference.
We are recruiting a Data Analyst to join us.

Responsibilities:

Customer & Commercial Analytics: analyse customer behaviour, journeys, and commercial performance to identify opportunities and explain changes in business performance.
Insight Delivery: you’ll be directly responsible for extracting, manipulating and interpreting the wealth of information available to elevate your stakeholders beyond BAU reporting, allowing them to make decisions from a position of knowledge.
Marketing: extend your knowledge of online & offline marketing to analyse campaigns, customer touchpoints and behaviour; understanding how different channels influence commercial trade.
Clickstream: become an expert in clickstream and behavioural data, so you can support our main stakeholders in understanding our digital journey and its value to the business.
Subject Matter Expertise: you must be experienced with analytical methods, utilising and further developing knowledge of techniques such as cohort analysis, customer segmentation, experimentation, applying appropriate approaches with support from the wider team.
Delivery Management: value-led prioritisation of your work and ensuring excellence in day-to-day operational and project delivery.
Stakeholder Collaboration: work with stakeholders to understand their challenges, share insights confidently and progressively take ownership of analytical work.

Personal Profile:

Analytical curiosity and problem-solving: able to explore data, ask the right questions and break ambiguous problems into clear analytical steps.
Strong communication and influencing skills: able to explain insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders and tailor recommendations to the audience.
Collaborative working style: confident working with others, building credibility with stakeholders and valuing different perspectives.
Creative and commercial thinking: brings new ideas, shows interest in technology and focuses on delivering meaningful business value.
Ownership and prioritisation: able to manage time effectively, work independently and communicate delivery timelines clearly.
Growth mindset: motivated to keep developing technical, commercial and business knowledge, including new tools and analytical approaches.

Required Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative, scientific, engineering or related discipline.
Strong SQL or data querying skills, with hands-on experience querying, manipulating and validating datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving foundations, with the ability to investigate questions, identify patterns and draw evidence-based conclusions.
Experience delivering data-led analysis or deep-dive investigations on complex topics, working independently and collaboratively to shape clear recommendations.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical audiences.
Experience with BI or data visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI is beneficial.
Exposure to clickstream data, segmentation, cohort analysis, experimentation, forecasting, statistical analysis, commerce, digital or marketing technology is advantageous but not essential.

Burberry is an Equal Opportunities Employer and as such, treats all applications equally and recruits purely on the basis of skills and experience.

We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team

The Business & Strategy Analytics team's mission is to transform data into strategic insights that empower our leaders to make informed decisions, effectively track progress, and unlock growth opportunities. Through deep metric understanding, holistic business views, and detailed analytics, we enable concrete actions that drive business success.

Working closely with the Director of FP&A, CFO, and senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Data, you’ll support strategic planning, fundraising, and Preply’s journey toward IPO through rigorous, business-focused analytics.

What you’ll be doing

Partner with the FP&A team to provide analytical insights that shape strategic planning, forecasting, and company performance.
Deliver executive-ready analyses and presentations that support leadership decision-making, fundraising activities, and Preply’s roadmap toward IPO.
Lead end-to-end analytical initiatives, translating ambiguous business questions into executive-ready recommendations and measurable business impact.
Develop forecasting models, scenario analyses, driver-based models, and opportunity sizing to evaluate strategic decisions and quantify financial impact.
Connect Product, Marketing, and Operational initiatives with business performance, identifying the key drivers behind revenue, profitability, and efficiency.
Conduct deep dives into business performance to uncover growth opportunities, operational improvements, and emerging risks.
Partner across Finance, Product, Marketing, Operations, and the Data Chapter to establish a trusted, consistent view of business performance and key metrics.
Continuously improve analytical frameworks, business metrics, and decision-support models that enable scalable, data-informed decision making.

What You Need To Succeed

5+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Growth Analytics, Financial Analytics, or a similar analytical role.
Strong SQL skills and confidence independently working with large, complex datasets.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence VP and C-level stakeholders.
Strong analytical and critical thinking, with the ability to simplify complex business problems into actionable insights.
Proven experience building forecasting models, scenario analyses, financial impact models, and driver-based analyses.
Experience leading cross-functional analytical initiatives from problem definition through implementation.
Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
A proactive, curious mindset with strong business intuition and a focus on pragmatic problem solving.
Familiarity with AI tools that improve analytical productivity and decision-making.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets modeling skills.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.

Nice to have

Experience partnering closely with FP&A or Corporate Finance teams.
Experience in fast-growing technology companies, marketplaces, SaaS, or subscription businesses.
Comfortable working with P&L statements and financial performance analysis.
Familiarity with key business and marketplace metrics such as LTV, CAC, payback period, retention, and ARPU.
Background in strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, or venture capital.
Experience with Snowflake and Looker.

Why you’ll love it at Preply

Help shape Preply’s next stage of growth, supporting strategic planning, fundraising, and our journey toward IPO.
Work directly with our Director of FP&A, CFO, and senior leaders on company-wide strategic priorities.
Own high-impact analytical initiatives spanning Finance, Product, Marketing, and Operations.
Influence executive decisions through data, strategic thinking, and business partnering.
Join a collaborative, high-performing team where your analyses directly contribute to company performance and long-term success.

Our Principles

Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Job Summary

Part of the Forestry Commission family, Forest Research is a world leader in applied forest science, providing evidence and practical solutions to policy makers, forestry practitioners, land managers and anyone with green space, UK-wide. With climate and biodiversity in crisis, and an increasing number of pests and diseases, our research is more vital than ever before. We advise on how woodlands can help combat climate change. We’re identifying tree species that will thrive in the future and ways of safeguarding those species at risk. Our research supports UK timber production because fewer imports reduce carbon emissions. We provide data on forests in Scotland, Wales and England, and provide evidence of the societal benefits of woodland. We do all this working collaboratively with academia, partners and industry, nationally and internationally.

The Forest Information and Statistics team is a multi-disciplinary team including statisticians, spatial analysts, data scientists and others.  There are 3 teams within Forest Information and Statistics, covering National Forest Inventory scheduling and mapping, National Forest Inventory analysis and outputs, and Statistics. Together, they are responsible for overseeing data collection and providing analysis and support to a range of internal and external customers and for producing a range of analytical outputs, including official statistics and the National Forest Inventory. 

Job Description

The purpose of the job is to contribute to policy development, monitoring and evaluation of sustainable forest management by supporting analysis and provision of advice on economic aspects of forestry. The postholder will also support Forest Research’s Official Statistics team in ensuring compliance with the Code of Practice for Statistics.

Key Work Areas:

Working with the project lead on the development of statistics on timber utilisation to support the timber in construction roadmap, by consulting on requirements, identifying data sources and developing a methodology to produce statistics on the use of wood fibre.
Using R and/or SAS to process data and test methodology for statistics produced as part of the Official Statistics outputs and timber utilisation.
Supporting the economic lead with the collection and management of data on economic aspects of forestry (annual surveys of the UK timber industry and other data sources) by carrying out data cleaning and compiling reports using their outputs.
Working with other members of the team to carry out quality assurance of Official Statistics and the methods used to produce them to ensure compliance with the Code of Practice for Statistics.
Attending cross-departmental groups with the economic lead, such as the Expert Group on Timber & Trade Statistics, to stay up to date on discussions that have an impact on the statistics produced in the team.
